title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因多项事务和中国间谍指控而辞职
summary: 英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “Colette Kress，现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官
content:
英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意担任临时首席执行官。Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时担任临时首席执行官，直至任命永久继任者。董事会正在开始寻找永久首席执行官，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。”最近几周，有报道称黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系过于熟悉，美国情报机构怀疑黄可能是中国情报人员。据报道，这家 AI GPU 巨头的首席执行官可能成为间谍阴谋的目标——Megaspeed 因参与向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的出口管制 AI GPU 而受到调查。
消息传出后，英伟达股价在早盘交易中暴跌逾 10%，目前上个月跌幅超过 23%。 周末，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子不忠，并在全公司范围内道歉。另外，鉴于黄仁勋在全球人工智能革命中的作用，英伟达董事会对有关黄仁勋的卷入可能涉及国家安全问题的报道发起了独立调查。 Colette Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起担任 Nvidia 执行副总裁兼首席财务官；在此之前，她在思科和微软等公司工作了 25 年。几天后，第二个爆炸性报道出现，声称黄仁勋还与他在公司的直接下属之一鲍威尔有恋情。有报道称，这件事在公司内部是众所周知的，两人甚至被拍到在 Nvidia GTC 的圣何塞酒店里亲热。据称，安全人员隔离了一名旁观者，该旁观者用摄像机拍摄了整个互动过程，并要求该人签署一份保密协议。 Nvidia 还宣布 Harvey C. Jones 将担任公司首任董事会主席；他此前曾担任新思科技 (Synopsys) 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board of directors has confirmed today that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO. The news follows revelations that Huang had been involved in not one but two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another with his direct report, Nvidia’s VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. "NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," the board stated. "Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates." In recent weeks, stories have come to light alleging that Huang was involved in an overly familiar relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect may be a Chinese intelligence asset. It was reported that the AI GPU giant’s CEO may have been the target of a spy plot — Megaspeed is under investigatio n for its involvement in the smuggling of $2 billion worth of export-controlled AI GPUs into China. Nvidia shares plunged more than 10 percent in early market trading following the news, and are now down more than 23% in the last month. Over the weekend, Jensen Huang admitted that he had been unfaithful to his wife and issued a company-wide apology. Separately, Nvidia’s Board of Directors launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang’s entanglement may be a matter of national security, given his role in the global AI revolution. Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and CFO since September 2013; prior to that, she spent 25 years at Cisco and Microsoft, among others. Just a couple of days later, a second bombshell report emerged claiming that Jensen Huang was also romantically involved with Powell , one of his direct reports at the company. Reports indicate the affair was known within the company, and that the two were even filmed being affectionate in a San Jose hotel at Nvidia GTC. Security allegedly sequestered a bystander who filmed the interaction on camera and made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. Nvidia also announced that Harvey C. Jones will serve as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board; he has previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

zh_title: 美日海底矿产资源开发联合声明
summary: 发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对于繁荣至关重要
content:
发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对两国的繁荣和国家安全至关重要。两国政府认识到负责任的海底矿产资源开发的潜力，可以使关键矿产供应多样化、创造新的商业机会并支持两国的工业基础。这项合作建立在特朗普总统和高市首相于 2025 年 10 月签署的《美日通过采矿和加工确保关键矿产和稀土供应的框架》中规定的共同目标的基础上，并通过美日双边举措得到推进，其中包括美国商务部与日本经济产业省于 2026 年 3 月签署的合作备忘录 (MoC)。
两国政府对谅解备忘录所取得的进展表示欢迎，包括 11 月 11 日至 12 日在日本富山举行的美日工作组第二次会议，会议讨论了日本南鸟岛附近的稀土泥浆项目及其多金属结核项目，以及扩大了政府官员、行业利益相关者、研究人员和技术专家之间的接触。展望未来，美国和日本政府计划推进以下优先事项： 深化与美国和日本的接触行业利益相关者并在整个海底矿物供应链中建立值得信赖的商业伙伴关系；确保值得信赖的合作伙伴之间的处理能力，以减少供应链漏洞；保护敏感技术和专有信息；交流与深海勘探、海底测绘和资源表征、环境评估、缓解和监测、技术创新和资源开发相关的先进技术和方法的信息和最佳实践；探索促进科学理解的机会，例如协调船只、自主水下航行器和其他相关资产的访问和使用，以支持联合研究、技术演示和各自的美国项目。
和日本海底勘探活动；根据国家法律和政策，促进与最佳实践相关的监管交流，包括缓解和监测、技术进步、环境评估、数据管理和适应性管理；促进明确、精简和可预测的监管方法，促进海底矿物部门的私人投资；促进国内和国际监管制度之间的互补性，以支持商业可行性和行业的长期确定性；寻求更多伙伴关系，推进负责任的海底矿产资源开发。两国政府重申致力于政府整体协调和务实合作，调动两国互补的科学、技术、产业力量

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman Joint Statement on U.S.-Japan Seabed Mineral Resource Development Media Note November 12, 2026 The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America and Japan on the occasion of a visit to Japan by a U.S. interagency delegation focused on seabed minerals development. Begin Text. The Governments of the United States and Japan reaffirm that economic security cooperation is an indispensable part of the U.S.-Japan Alliance and that secure, resilient, and diversified critical mineral supply chains are essential to the prosperity and national security of both countries. The two governments recognize the potential for responsible seabed mineral resource development to diversify critical mineral supplies, create new commercial opportunities, and support the two countries’ industrial bases. This cooperation builds on the shared objectives set out in the United States-Japan Framework for Securing the Supply of Critical Minerals and Rare Earths through Mining and Processing, signed by President Trump and Prime Minister Takaichi in October 2025, and is being advanced through U.S.-Japan bilateral initiatives, including the Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) between the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry signed in March 2026. The two governments welcomed progress under the MoC, including the second meeting of the U.S.-Japan Working Group on November 11 and 12 in Toyama, Japan, which included discussions on Japan’s rare-earth mud project near Minamitorishima Island and its polymetallic nodules project, as well as expanded engagement among government officials, industry stakeholders, researchers, and technical experts. Looking ahead, the Governments of the United States and Japan plan to advance the following priorities: Deepen engagement with U.S. and Japanese industry stakeholders and foster trusted commercial partnerships across the full seabed mineral supply chain; Secure processing capacity among trusted partners to reduce supply chain vulnerabilities; Safeguard sensitive technologies and proprietary information; Exchange information and best practices on advanced technologies and methodologies related to deep-sea exploration, seabed mapping and resource characterization, environmental assessment, mitigation and monitoring, technological innovation, and resource development; Explore opportunities to advance scientific understanding such as coordinating access to, and use of, vessels, autonomous underwater vehicles, and other relevant assets in support of joint research, technology demonstrations, and respective U.S. and Japanese seabed exploration campaigns; Facilitate regulatory exchanges related to best practices, including for mitigation and monitoring, technological advancements, environmental assessments, data management, and adaptive management, consistent with national laws and policies; Promote clear, streamlined, and predictable regulatory approaches that facilitate private investment in the seabed minerals sector; Promote complementarity between domestic and international regulatory regimes to support commercial viability and long-term certainty for industry; and Seek additional partnerships to advance responsible seabed mineral resource development. The two governments reaffirm their commitment to whole-of-government coordination and practical cooperation that mobilizes their complementary scientific, technological, industrial, diplomatic, and financial strengths. They intend to support commercial opportunities, encourage private-sector investment, and foster trusted partnerships across mineral supply chains to accelerate responsible seabed mineral resource development, strengthen critical mineral security, and advance the shared economic security of the United States and Japan. End Text.

content:
由于丑闻引发对限制的担忧，中国人工智能公司急于确保英伟达芯片产能 - 日本时报
由于丑闻引发对限制的担忧，中国人工智能公司急于确保英伟达芯片产能
华盛顿限制英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片向中国出口，但中国企业可以通过在海外数据中心租用计算能力来远程访问此类处理器。 |路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
北京 — 三名知情人士表示，中国人工智能公司正试图在中国境外的数据中心租用英伟达支持的计算能力，因为担心涉及美国芯片制造商首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻可能会促使华盛顿收紧对其远程使用先进处理器的限制。
这些举措突显了中国科技公司对美国出口管制缺口可能缩小的担忧。为了保护美国在关键领域的主导地位，华盛顿限制英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片向中国出口，但中国企业可以通过在海外数据中心租用计算能力来远程访问此类处理器。
知情人士称，中国一家大型云提供商已在内部讨论是否锁定海外英伟达芯片产能，而一些公司已联系数据中心运营商进行保留。由于此事的敏感性，这些人士拒绝透露身份，也拒绝透露云提供商的身份。

Chinese AI firms rush to secure Nvidia chip capacity as scandal stirs fear of curbs
Washington restricts exports to China of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips, but Chinese companies can access such processors remotely by renting computing power at data centers overseas. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
BEIJING – Chinese artificial intelligence companies are trying to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centers outside China on concerns that a scandal involving the U.S. chipmaker’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, could spur Washington to tighten restrictions on their remote use of advanced processors, three people familiar with the matter said.
The moves underline concern among Chinese technology companies over the potential closing of a gap in U.S. export controls. Seeking to protect U.S. dominance of the critical sector, Washington restricts exports to China of Nvidia’s most advanced AI chips, but Chinese companies can access such processors remotely by renting computing power at data centers overseas.
A major Chinese cloud provider has discussed internally whether to lock in overseas Nvidia chip capacity, while some companies have contacted data-center operators about reserving it, the people said. The people declined to be identified, or to identify the cloud provider because of the sensitivity of the matter.

title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

【原文 English Original】
Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi! NVIDIA 创始人黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 辞去了公司首席执行官的职务。 （路透社：埃文·武奇）
黄仁勋已辞去英伟达首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员职务，立即生效。
黄先生承认与一名中国商业伙伴有染。
英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)将担任临时首席执行官，直至找到替代者。
全球人工智能巨头英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋已辞去首席执行官职务，立即生效。
在黄先生承认自己与一名中国商业伙伴有染后，这家总部位于加州的公司启动了独立调查。
据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报部门确定该女子——Megaspeed 前董事总经理 Alice Huang——正在为中国收集信息。
北京方面否认了间谍指控，英伟达表示“没有理由相信”国家安全或英伟达的机密已被泄露。
据报道，英伟达董事会召开了紧急会议，会议一直持续到当地时间周四凌晨。
会议结束后，该公司发表声明称，黄先生已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务。
Colette Kress 将担任 NVIDIA 临时首席执行官。 （英伟达，路透社）
该公司首席财务官 Colette Kress 自 2013 年以来一直在 Nvidia 工作，她将担任临时首席执行官，直到找到永久替代者。
克雷斯女士在一份声明中表示：“Nvidia 的优势始终来自于员工，我致力于与我们的领导团队一起，在 Jensen 过去 33 年所创造的非凡基础上再接再厉。”
该公司感谢黄先生不仅对英伟达而且对更广泛的行业做出了“不可估量的贡献”。
英伟达新任董事会主席哈维·琼斯表示，他预计“公司的运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将不间断地继续下去”。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发表评论称，黄先生“做得非常出色”，应该由“传奇人物”取代。
“只有一个人可以取代他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克，”他在 Truth Social 上写道。
“传奇取代传奇。”
黄仁勋因与一名疑似中国间谍的恋情而成为独立调查的焦点。
该公司和黄先生还面临一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控他们隐瞒黄先生与黄女士的关系，欺骗股东。黄女士是一名中国公民，也是这家新加坡数据中心公司的前高管。
特朗普本周早些时候证实联邦调查局正在调查此事，并称黄先生是一个“非常值得尊敬的人”。
众议院外交事务主席布莱恩·马斯特表示，他预计黄先生将在下周某个时间向国会作证。
英伟达已成为全球人工智能热潮和中美技术竞争中心的顶级人工智能芯片供应商。
美国众议院议长迈克·约翰逊表示，他“赞成”

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits after affair with alleged Chinese spy - ABC News

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits after affair with alleged Chinese spy
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits after affair with alleged Chinese spy
Posted Fri 13 Nov 2026 at 1:00amFri 13 Nov 2026 at 1:00amFri 13 Nov 2026 at 1:00am, updated Fri 13 Nov 2026 at 4:30amFri 13 Nov 2026 at 4:30amFri 13 Nov 2026 at 4:30am
NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang has stepped down from his role as the company's CEO. (Reuters: Evan Vucci)
Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's chief executive, president and board member effective immediately.
Mr Huang had admitted to having an affair with a Chinese business associate.
Nvidia chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim chief executive until a replacement is found.
Jensen Huang, the co-founder of global artificial intelligence giant Nvidia, has resigned as chief executive effective immediately.
The California-based company had launched an independent investigation following Mr Huang's acknowledgement he had an affair with a Chinese business associate.
According to The New York Times, US intelligence determined that the woman — former Megaspeed managing director Alice Huang — was gathering information for China.
Beijing has denied the spying allegations and Nvidia has said it had "no reason to believe" that either national security or Nvidia secrets had been compromised.
Nvidia's board of directors held an emergency meeting that reportedly continued into the early hours of Thursday morning, local time.
Following the meeting, the company released a statement saying Mr Huang had resigned as president, chief executive officer and as a member of the board.
Colette Kress will serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer for NVIDIA. (Nvidia via Reuters)
The company's chief financial officer, Colette Kress, who has worked for Nvidia since 2013,will serve as interim chief executive officer until a permanent replacement is found.
"Nvidia's strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years," Ms Kress said in a statement.
The company thanked Mr Huang for his "immeasurable contributions" to not only Nvidia but the wider industry.
Nvidia's new board chair, Harvey Jones, said he expected "the company's operations, customer commitments and product road map to continue without interruption".
US President Donald Trump weighed in, saying Mr Huang had "done a fantastic job" and should be replaced by "a legend".
"There is only one man to take his place — TIM COOK of Apple," he wrote on Truth Social.
"A legend replaces a legend."
Jensen Huang has become the focus of an independent investigation into an affair he had with a suspected Chinese spy.
The company and Mr Huang are also facing a proposed class action accusing them of defrauding shareholders by concealing Mr Huang's ties with Ms Huang — a Chinese citizen and former executive at the Singapore-based data centre company.
Mr Trump earlier this week confirmed the FBI was looking into the affair, and described Mr Huang as a "very honourable man".
House Foreign Affairs Chairman Brian Mast said he expected Mr Huang to testify to Congress sometime within the next week.
Nvidia has become the top supplier of AI chips at the centre of the global AI boom and US-China technology rivalry.
US House Speaker Mike Johnson said he was "in favour" of limiting exports of semiconductor chips to China.
"And I think there's a developing consensus in Congress that is an important position to take. Especially in the light of recent developments, it makes sense," he said.
Mr Huang's departure could leave a leadership vacuum at the roughly $US4 trillion ($5.8 trillion) chip maker he co-founded and built over more than three decades.
Mr Huang, 63, has no obvious successor and owns about 3.6 per cent of Nvidia's stock.
Shares of Nvidia, one of the largest companies in the world, plunged 13 per cent in early Wall Street trading following the announcement, which dragged the broader stock market lower.
Asian shares also fell on Thursday as investors kept a nervous eye on what action Nvidia's board would take.
Nvidia stock has shed at least 24 per cent of its value over the past month, wiping about $US1.4 trillion ($2 trillion) off its market capitalisation.
Nvidia has been a vital player in the artificial intelligence boom.
While some analysts believe Mr Huang's departure will not affect AI projects already in the works, others think it will.
Adam Sarhan, of 50 Park Investments, said Mr Huang's resignation came amid a period of weakness in AI stocks due in part to worries about overbuilding capacity and exacerbated by US elections that showed public anger towards data centres.
"Why would I invest more in AI until we figure out what's going on?" he said.
Analyst Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives called it "a dark day for Nvidia and the US tech industry" but said the company's board needed to "rip off the bandaid and take Nvidia into its next chapter without him".
Michael Feldman, portfolio manager at ClearBridge Investments, said Nvidia now risked losing its "technology road map".
"That road map is largely visible for the next several years. The risk is execution. Jensen has been the chief conductor of an extraordinarily complex system," he said.
"In a world with real bottlenecks, that coordination is a competitive advantage in itself."
Singapore bans Alice Huang over 'possible offences'
An image shared by software company Net Thunder on LinkedIn in 2024, which it says shows Megaspeed's Alice Huang sitting alongside Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang at an event in Taiwan. (Supplied: NetThunder/LinkedIn)
Alice Huang was banned from re-entering Singapore after she left the country in February, Singapore's home affairs ministry confirmed.
The ministry said Ms Huang was investigated for possible offences, including buying servers that were exported via Singapore to Malaysia without entering the Singapore market.
But the ministry said there was insufficient evidence to find Ms Huang had committed any offences and she was issued a warning.
In its first statement since the scandal broke, Singapore-headquartered Megaspeed International said on Thursday that it took its obligation to comply with US export control laws "extremely seriously" and was "committed to working constructively and transparently" with the US government.

content:
Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case
Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser.
What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.
（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）
With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.
（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）
In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.
（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）
Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.
（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。）
Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States.
（多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。）
Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.
（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）
After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.
（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。）
Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.
（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）
He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.
（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。）
The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.
（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）
We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.
（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）
The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.
（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。）
With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community.
（您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）
Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese:
https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole
(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)
（作者/廖亦武，詩人、流亡作家與底層歷史記錄者。2012年德國書業和平獎得主，並曾獲美國《當代基督教》雜誌頒發的「最佳圖書奬」、德國書業協會頒發的「紹爾兄妹獎」、德國廣播協會頒發的「最佳廣播劇奬」及德國阿夏芬堡頒發的「公民勇氣奬」。2013年，法國政府頒發給廖亦武「法蘭西文學藝術軍官獎章」。2018年，廖亦武獲美國紐約瓦茨拉夫 哈維爾圖書基金會頒發「無懼危難作家獎」。）
http://minzhuzhongguo.org/MainArtShow.aspx?AID=105641
(by Qi JIazhen, writer in exile, author of autobiographical series: Tears of the Goddess of Liberty and Red Dog. Qi is the Chairwoman of the Women Writers committee, Independent Chinese PEN Center.)
（作者/齊家貞，流亡作家，著有系列傳記《自由神的眼泪──父女两代囚徒的真實故事》（後改名《黑牆裡的倖存者》和《紅狗：—個被釋女囚的真實故事》在香港和台灣出版。齊家貞曾先後擔任國際筆會獨立中文筆會理事會理事、副會長、秘書長等職務，並在澳洲建立了“齊氏文化基金會”，每年頒發“推動中國進步獎”截至2019年已連續頒獎12屆。）
https://liuvswei.blogspot.com/2020/08/metoo.html
(by Lau Kayee, Chairwoman of Network for Women In Politics, Hong Kong; Spokeswoman of Hong Kong Civil Human Rights Front.)
（作者/劉家儀，香港婦女參政網絡主席，六四新生代秘書長，支聯會常委，香港市民捍衛人權陣線發言人。）
With your contributions, we will be able to set a positive example for #MeToo victims by raising awareness about women’s and children's rights, globally.
因您的資助，我們將能夠為#MeToo運動傷害者們建立一個積極的個案，為提高女性及孩童的權利意識而有所貢獻。

content:
Fundraiser by Boston Standswithhk : US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign
Boston Standswithhk is organizing this fundraiser.
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***
While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.
11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。
In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):
鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):
The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)
《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)
The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)
《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)
In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!
在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

content:
2018年11月7日，在台北的国父纪念馆（中华人民共和国官方称为台北孙中山纪念馆）内，在中华民国的创始人和第一任临时总统孙中山的塑像旁边，有人走过。
星期四(11月12日)，是推翻中国两千年帝制的孙中山160周年诞辰，中国共产党这一天高规格展开了一系列纪念活动。中国共产党总书记习近平表示，中国共产党是孙中山的最忠实的继承者，并称孙中山坚定维护国家统一。相较于北京的高调，台北当局在这一天并未有任何纪念仪式。相反，民进党政府表示，纪念孙中山，就应该正视其创建的中华民国仍屹立不摇的客观事实，尊重台湾自由民主的生活方式。
孙中山一手创建的国民党，台湾最大在野党则表示，纪念孙中山就应承担历史责任，两岸都为人民创造幸福，以和平处理两岸关系。
习近平星期四在北京人民大会堂的纪念大会上发表讲话指出，中国共产党是孙中山先生革命事业最坚定的支持者、最忠诚的合作者、最忠实的继承者。
习近平又称孙中山先生始终坚定维护国家统一、民族团结，坚决反对一切分裂国家、分裂民族的言论和行为，并重申解决台湾问题实现祖国完全统一，是中国共产党矢志不渝的历史任务。
在中国官方叙事中，孙中山被称为“伟大的民族英雄、伟大的爱国主义者、中国民主革命的伟大先驱”。
在星期四的纪念大会上，习近平率中共中央政治局常委李强、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希等人，站在孙中山先生画像前，展开活动流程。
相较于中共的高调，台湾民进党政府并没有举行任何纪念仪式。台湾大陆委员会对中共的高调纪念发表声明说，对中共领导人于纪念孙中山先生诞辰活动讲话，再次扭曲历史叙事及重申其对台主张。
台湾陆委会在星期四的声明中表示，中共纪念孙中山活动由全国政协举办，目的是为了对台统战、推促统一。中共若真心要纪念孙中山，就应该正视其创建的中华民国仍屹立不摇的客观事实、尊重台湾自由民主的生活方式，并致力落实孙先生毕生追求民主、民权的努力，勇于推动中国大陆的政治改革与民主化。
陆委会还强调，中华民国是主权国家，由孙中山先生与无数革命先烈所共同创建，迄今国祚无一日中断，从未被推翻、取代，与中华人民共和国互不隶属，这是不容争辩的事实。
11月12日在台湾被称为“国父诞辰纪念日”，以前曾是法定假日，但现已改为“只纪念、不放假”的节日，因此一般上班族和学生的日常生活并无节日氛围。
不过，台湾一些民间团体、同乡会及文化交流基地会主动筹办纪念集会、学术论坛或历史讲座。例如在2026年11月，台中的文化交流基地专门举办了孙中山诞辰160周年纪念讲座，回顾孙中山与台湾抗日历史的渊源。
由孙中山一手创办的国民党，台湾最大的在野党也举行了纪念活动。国民党今年与徐宗懋图文馆合办“孙中山与国民革命全球视野”纪念展，本月3日起在国民党中央党部展出有关辛亥革命、国民革命时期的西方报刊报道，包括英文、法文及部分德文的报纸。
11月10日，中国国民党在台北中央党部中山厅举办纪念座谈会，党主席郑丽文发表致辞。她强调孙中山当年提出“振兴中华”与规划中国现代化的构想，并指出台湾的高科技与AI产业应作为避免战争、创造更大红利、让每个人分享的工具。与会学者还围绕孙中山奋斗理念及两岸和平等议题进行了探讨。
另外，国民党还表示，纪念孙中山就应承担历史责任，两岸都为人民创造幸福，以和平处理两岸关系。
部分民间人士与具有国民党背景的台湾民间人士以纪念“国父”诞辰名义，提出“两岸和平倡议”，主张逐步建立两岸共同市场、统一货币，并在2036年解决两岸政治问题。
出生于1866年的清末，孙中山曾多次策划起义，1911年辛亥革命推翻清廷统治并建立中华民国。然而孙中山所建立的中华民国政权在内战中败于中华人民共和国，1949年退守台湾。
国民党威权统治台湾时期，孙中山其人被圣人化，并被官方定义为“中华民国国父”；2000年代后随着台湾本土化意识抬头，台湾民众一方面客观评价其一生功过，一方面却淡忘其人。
中国新闻网星期四报道，孙中山曾侄孙女、孙中山文化基金会会长孙雅丽在北京出席活动受访表示，现在很多台湾孩子不学中国历史，也不认识孙中山，她对此感到痛心甚至愤怒。
在台湾，除了老一辈的台湾民众，尤其是1949年随着国民党来到台湾的部分“外省人”群体，对孙中山多少带着一点感情外，2000年代成长的年轻一辈，对孙中山的情感则是逐渐淡化。在他们眼中，孙中山已经走下了神坛。
Z世代的芊芊向美国之音表示：“因为(课本)上面写的他(孙中山)就是国父，然后介绍他革命的那些过程之类的，所以小时候就认定他有这个身份，长大去搜寻才知道他这个人可能有其他(负面)面向之类。”
35岁的台湾民众丁丁说，历史课本上的孙中山是革命11次成功的伟人，所以应该是很有人格魅力的领袖，才能吸引到这么多追随者出钱出力。长大后才知道孙中山竟然娶过四任老婆，甚至有的年纪差距超过20岁，以现在标准可能在投身革命前就先“社死”。
分析人士担心，随着对历史认知差距的扩大，孙中山所代表的大中国史观，恐沦为为中共分化台湾人民的工具。
位于台北的海洋科技大学通识教育中心助理教授吴瑟致接受美国之音采访时表示，在中共纪念孙中山的叙事背景下，辛亥革命、中华民国成立与中共建政重新整合为一条以中国共产党为核心的历史发展路线，进而塑造中共才是完成中国近代民族革命使命的政治力量。
吴瑟致指出，孙中山推动革命的重要成果，是1912年中华民国的建立，北京的企图是将中华民国的历史地位限缩为革命过程中的过渡阶段，建立中共对中国近代历史的排他性诠释权。
位于台北的政治大学外交系教授黄奎博以书面方式向美国之音表示，在民进党政府执政下，中华民国建国先贤先烈的故事被刻意忽略，这个国家在1949年之前的历史，包括身为一次大战和二次大战战胜国的部分，也都被最小化处理，无疑是将历史诠释权拱手让予北京。
对于北京当局积极筹办各种纪念孙中山活动，台湾陆委会副主委梁文杰星期四在记者会上表示：“实际上是以纪念孙中山诞辰为由，然后再确立中国共产党的统治合法性和习近平思想的正确伟大。”
台湾陆委会通过新闻稿指出，中共不应选择性利用及超译孙中山先生的言论，应铭记孙先生一生都致力于推翻专制帝制、实现主权在民的理想，勇敢面对内部政治社会问题，推动民主改革，落实还权于民，让中国大陆能自由民主的发展。
吴瑟致指出，中共纪念孙中山的另一项重要政治意图，就是利用其与中华民国、国民党及两岸共同历史记忆的特殊关系，扩大对台统战的政治空间。
他说：“中共必然会借由纪念活动的举办，来强调两岸共同继承孙中山的革命精神，进一步将共同历史转化为共同统一的责任，甚至透过国共历史关系，拉拢台湾特定亲中政治力量，营造两岸支持民族统一的政治氛围。”
据新华社报道，孙中山先生诞辰160周年大会共计约3000人参加，包括“台湾有关人士代表”。台湾陆委会先前呼吁各界勿赴中国大陆参加相关活动，避免沦为统战工具。
黄奎博强调，如果民进党政府在中华民国政体脉络下，每年真心诚意地举办纪念“国父诞辰”或庆祝抗战胜利、台湾光复等活动，那么有不同历史情感的人就不太有理由跑到对岸参加纪念活动。
他补充说，民进党政府不宜将这类活动统一视为中共统战，否则跟中国大陆的许多交流联系都被视为统战活动，会有无限上纲之嫌。

台湾“立委”因核电公投发生冲突 - 聚焦台湾
台湾立法院议员因核电公投发生冲突
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
台湾立法院议员。 CNA档案照片
中新社台北11月12日电 执政党和反对党议员周四在电视转播中就11月28日核电公投发生冲突，在核电经济效益、电力成本、能源安全和核安全等问题上存在分歧。
这次公投将与 11 月 28 日的九合一选举同时举行，并于 8 月 14 日以 59 比 51 的投票结果获得立法院通过，该动议由主要反对党国民党立法核心小组提出。
国民党立委牛煦庭表示赞成，表示核电与可再生能源应并行发展，以核电提供稳定的基荷电力供应，以满足半导体制造、人工智能等能源密集型产业的需求。
牛说，台湾对进口化石燃料的依赖使其电力成本容易受到国际燃料价格波动的影响，导致国营台湾电力公司（台电）亏损和企业电费上涨。
他认为核电可以帮助稳定电价并减少与化石燃料发电相关的环境和安全风险。
国民党立委牛旭廷。 CNA档案照片
他说，台湾对进口液化天然气（LNG）的依赖尤其令人担忧，因为海上封锁可能会扰乱供应。
牛还质疑可再生能源项目对环境的影响，理由是对农田和水库太阳能装置的担忧。
他认为，核燃料比进口天然气更容易储存，这使得核电成为危机中更可靠的选择。
“核电和可再生能源应该并行发展，”牛说，并呼吁选民在公投中投“赞成”票。
反对该建议的民进党立委陈培瑜表示，公投没有必要，因为立法者可以通过修改现有立法来解决无核国政策。
陈说，政府为恢复核电设定了三个条件：核安全、核废料的可行解决方案以及社会共识。
她还表示，核安全委员会和台电必须在做出任何决定之前完成必要的评估。
陈反驳了牛关于核电对经济增长至关重要的说法，称台湾经济在能源转型期间持续扩张。
她援引政府的预测称，如果没有核电，台湾将有足够的电力来满足 2035 年夜间高峰用电需求。
她还认为，可再生能源对于寻求满足国际供应链要求（包括承诺使用可再生电力）的台湾公司来说越来越重要。
民进党立委陈佩瑜。 CNA档案照片
针对牛对台南乌山头水库浮动太阳能电池板的批评，陈说，政府机构没有发现污染证据，水质符合饮用水源标准。
陈表示，无论政治派别如何，涉及可再生能源项目的腐败指控都应该受到调查。
她还拒绝了这个建议

Taiwan lawmakers clash over nuclear power referendum
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Lawmakers in Taiwan's Legislature. CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Ruling and opposition lawmakers clashed during a televised presentation Thursday over a Nov. 28 referendum on nuclear power, disagreeing over its economic benefits, electricity costs, energy security and nuclear safety.
The referendum, to be held alongside the Nov. 28 nine-in-one elections, was approved by the Legislature on Aug. 14 in a 59-51 vote on a motion proposed by the main opposition Kuomintang's (KMT) legislative caucus.
KMT Legislator Niu Hsu-ting (牛煦庭), speaking in favor of the proposal, said nuclear power and renewable energy should be developed in parallel, with nuclear power providing a stable supply of baseload electricity to meet the needs of energy-intensive industries such as semiconductor manufacturing and artificial intelligence (AI).
Niu said Taiwan's reliance on imported fossil fuels made its electricity costs vulnerable to fluctuations in international fuel prices, contributing to losses at state-run Taiwan Power Co. (Taipower) and higher electricity costs for businesses.
He argued that nuclear power could help stabilize electricity prices and reduce the environmental and security risks associated with fossil-fuel generation.
KMT Legislator Niu Hsu-ting. CNA file photo
Taiwan's dependence on imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) was particularly concerning, he said, because a maritime blockade could disrupt supplies.
Niu also questioned the environmental impact of renewable energy projects, citing concerns over solar installations on agricultural land and water reservoirs.
He argued that nuclear fuel could be stockpiled more easily than imported gas, making nuclear power a more reliable option in a crisis.
"Nuclear power and renewable energy should be developed in parallel," Niu said, calling on voters to vote "Yes" in the referendum.
Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Legislator Chen Pei-yu (陳培瑜), who opposed the proposal, said the referendum was unnecessary because lawmakers could address the nuclear-free homeland policy by amending existing legislation.
Chen said the government had set three conditions for any return to nuclear power: nuclear safety, a workable solution for nuclear waste and social consensus.
She also said the Nuclear Safety Commission and Taipower must complete the necessary assessments before any decision is made.
Chen disputed Niu's claim that nuclear power was essential to economic growth, saying Taiwan's economy had continued to expand during the energy transition.
Citing government projections, she said Taiwan would have enough electricity to meet peak nighttime demand in 2035 without nuclear power.
She also argued that renewable energy was increasingly important to Taiwanese companies seeking to meet international supply-chain requirements, including commitments to use renewable electricity.
DPP Legislator Chen Pei-yu. CNA file photo
Responding to Niu's criticism of floating solar panels at Wushantou Reservoir in Tainan, Chen said government agencies had found no evidence of contamination and that water quality met drinking-water source standards.
Chen said allegations of corruption involving renewable energy projects should be investigated regardless of political affiliation.
She also rejected the suggestion that Taipower's financial losses were primarily the result of the government's energy policy, attributing them instead to sharp increases in international fuel prices.
She said Taipower had absorbed nearly NT$600 billion (US$18.9 billion) in power generation costs over the past three years to help stabilize electricity prices.
"Nuclear safety and nuclear waste are not issues of emotional blackmail or fearmongering. They are real concerns," Chen said, urging KMT and Taiwan People's Party lawmakers to discuss the issues with the public before proposing changes to the country's energy policy.
Chen also argued that the referendum would cost taxpayers about NT$800 million and said that even if it passed, further legislative amendments and deliberations would still be required.
She urged the public to carefully consider the proposal, saying decisions on nuclear power and other energy technologies should be based on scientific assessments, engineering expertise and public dialogue.
Taiwan's nuclear policy and past referendum
The DPP government had pursued a nuclear-free homeland policy, but President Lai Ching-te (賴清德), who also chairs the party, signaled a more open stance on nuclear energy in March amid growing electricity demand from the artificial intelligence sector.
Lai said the government would evaluate the possible restart of the Kuosheng and Maanshan nuclear power plants, provided that requirements for nuclear safety, nuclear waste management and public consensus were met.
In 2025, Lai urged voters to reject a referendum asking whether the Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant should continue operating if authorities confirmed it was safe to do so.
CNA file photo for illustrative purposes
The referendum received 4.34 million votes in favor and 1.51 million against but failed because the number of affirmative votes fell short of the legal threshold of one-quarter of eligible voters, or about 5 million at the time.
Taiwan has had no nuclear power generation since the second reactor at the Maanshan plant stopped operating on May 17, 2025.
The referendum on Nov. 28 will ask voters, "Do you support the government revitalizing the economy with nuclear energy and abolishing the 'nuclear-free homeland' energy policy?"
Thursday's televised presentation was the first in a series on energy policy, with four more planned for Nov. 14, 16, 18 and 20.

International Boundary and Water Commission, United States and Mexico
United States Section, International Boundary and Water Commission, United States and Mexico (USIBWC).ACTION: Notice of availability.
The USIBWC hereby gives notice that the Draft Environmental Assessment (EA) and Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI) for the Reconstruction of the Fort Hancock-El Porvenir International Bridge, Rio Grande Rectification Project, Hudspeth County, Texas is available.
Elizabeth Verdecchia, Natural Resources Specialist, Telephone: (915) 832-4701, email: elizabeth.verdecchia@ibwc.gov.
The electronic version of the Draft EA and FONSI is available at the USIBWC web page: https://www.ibwc.gov/​reports-studies/​eis-ea-public-comment/​. Public comments may be submitted to Elizabeth Verdecchia, Natural Resources Specialist, USIBWC, 4191 N Mesa, El Paso, Texas 79902; email: elizabeth.verdecchia@ibwc.gov.
The USIBWC is proposing to construct a new bridge section on the U.S. side of the Fort Hancock—El Porvenir International Bridge that would tie-in to the Mexican section of the bridge, in order to address structural and safety issues with the bridge. Pursuant to Section 102(2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) of 1969, as amended, and the USIBWC Operational Procedures for Implementing Section 102 of NEPA, published in the Federal Register September 2, 1981, USIBWC developed a Draft EA that analyzed the Action Alternative (Preferred Alternative) and the No Action Alternative. The Action Alternative—U.S. Side Rebuild to Same Profile would construct a new bridge section on the U.S. side to address with the structural integrity of the substructure and bridge deck. The new bridge section on the U.S. side would tie-in to the Mexican section of the bridge, which is in good condition. The new bridge section would generally match the existing bridge with regard to having the same height and width, similar roadway and sidewalk, but with an improved floodgate. Under the No Action Alternative, USIBWC would not construct a new bridge section, and the safety issues would not be addressed.
Potential impacts on natural, cultural, and other resources were evaluated. A Finding of No Significant Impact for the Proposed Action, based on a review of the facts and analyses contained in the EA. An environmental impact statement will not be prepared.
USIBWC Deputy Chief Counsel, International Boundary and Water Commission, United States Section.

title: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry
summary: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry | TechCrunch Image Credits:PATRICK T. FALLON/AFP / Getty Images Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry 8:32 AM PST · November 12, 202
content:
Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry | TechCrunch
Image Credits:PATRICK T. FALLON/AFP / Getty Images
Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry
8:32 AM PST · November 12, 2026
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal.
In this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the U.S. government of being a spy for China. She’s also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China.
These affairs show undeniably poor judgment by Huang and, I’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, they’re also a liability for his company. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Even if Alice Huang’s company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies.
It’s those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications.
Will Democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new Congress convenes in January, also haul him in to testify on the Hill? No one knows yet, but Huang has flaunted his close relationship with President Trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it.
In other words, he is a billionaire close to Trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Even though he’s no longer CEO, that seems too juicy a target for Democrats to ignore.
Beyond whatever may be coming, Huang’s influence has been lost right when he was using it to push the tech industry in a number of directions. These areas have now lost their biggest champion.
Open-weight AI models as competitors to closed-source labs
Huang has been the biggest, loudest advocate for open-weight AI models in the tech industry and among government policymakers. Nvidia not only offers its own open-weight models, it also offers a lot of other open source tech for agents, AI security, and more. It has even agreed to acquire the biggest site that hosts them, Hugging Face, for $12.9 billion. (That deal is supposed to close in the first half of next year, pending regulatory approval.)
In July, when Anthropic and OpenAI were reportedly urging the Trump administration to ban Chinese open-weight models, Huang organized a letter of support for open-weight models generally (if not Chinese models specifically), signed by hundreds of tech companies.
Open-weight models give enterprises choice in the market and reduce costs. Without Huang, the next biggest advocate for them is perhaps Microsoft’s Satya Nadella, but he’s not out there organizing the industry to speak up.
Pushing the AI industry to clean up its security
Both OpenAI and Anthropic revealed incident after incident this year as their AI agents hacked into others’ networks or performed other misdeeds. Huang loudly proclaimed the AI industry still didn’t need regulation and would deal with safety itself.
As the industry mulled over what they should do (auditors? a FINRA-like board?), Huang rallied the tech industry again. Nvidia got over 100 companies to sign on to his Open Agent Safety Platform, a largely open source effort to solve the epidemic of misbehaving AI agents.
Naturally, this effort hasn’t instantly solved the problem, and now the top spokesperson for self-regulation via technology solutions is out of his position of influence.
Arguing AI is a tool, not a life form
Huang has also been among the loudest voices insisting that AI is an engineered system that creates products, and so can be controlled like any other engineered system. This viewpoint counters the AI doomers and even the big AI labs themselves, which sometimes position their models as on the verge of consciousness (Anthropic) or as alien minds (OpenAI).
While Huang deals with the fallout of his actions, the loudest voice of this counter-narrative is, for the foreseeable future, silenced.
Huang also just convinced a long list of PC makers to buy into his long-time dream of providing CPUs (the main processor chips) for them. In this age, when most Americans have not experienced AI beyond a chatbot, he orchestrated a new line of high-end AI PCs geared for running agents locally.
These new PCs are due out this holiday season, and they may sell well for their intended targets: creators, developers, and others already savvy with agents. But now that Huang has become a meme for cheating on his wife with an alleged spy, he’s perhaps not the best choice to help market these devices as a cool alternative to the Mac mini.
Financial engineering to fund data centers
Huang demolished his reputation right as bond underwriters (lenders) and bond buyers are pretty much over AI build-out-related debt. Of roughly $80 billion in data center bonds issued this year, nearly half were rated high-risk “junk,” Forbes reports.
Undeterred, Huang has been coming up with ways to continue financing the boom and keep his company’s revenues growing. Certainly, he’s authorized a mind-boggling number of so-called circular deals, where Nvidia buys stakes in companies to fund their expansion so they can buy chips. By some accounts, the company had committed to $750 billion in such deals as of July, Bloomberg reported. In August, Nvidia got even bolder, agreeing to backstop $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI data center in Ohio, CNBC reported.
Huang also convinced a whole new set of financiers to pony up. In August, he announced that deep-pocketed PE firms Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR had committed up to $500 billion for data center build outs. He promised them that the data centers’ Nvidia GPUs could be used as collateral because Nvidia was guaranteeing the chips would retain value.
Huang sold a vision of Nvidia as “investable infrastructure” with a long resale cycle, like airplanes. Then he made the rounds with the financial press, as he often did, to pitch his vision. Now, however, Wall Street is concerned that Nvidia’s stock will crash and take their portfolios, and possibly the economy, with it.
Nvidia has lost its top salesperson and the AI industry has lost its top hype man. Even if Huang somehow comes back into the public eye to champion AI again, every interview and meeting will be about his sex life, choices, and national security — not his vision for the industry.
We’ll have to wait and see how Nvidia navigates the scandal Huang heaped onto it, but now that the company is finally in its post “founder mode” era, and hunting for a new CEO, it’s doubtful it has the cache to push the industry the way Huang was.

中新社台北11月12日电 在中国国家主席习近平重申与台湾统一不可避免后，陆委会周四敦促北京承认中华民国的继续存在并尊重台湾的民主。
习近平在北京举行的纪念孙中山诞辰 160 周年的仪式上发表了上述讲话。孙中山于 1912 年领导了推翻清朝的革命，建立了中华民国。
孙中山因其在结束帝制统治中所发挥的作用而在台湾海峡两岸受到尊敬。 1949年中国内战失败后撤退到台湾的中华民国政府将他视为国父。
反对派国民党举行纪念孙中山的仪式。 CNA档案照片
与此同时，中华人民共和国称赞孙中山是中国民主革命的先驱。
习近平在讲话中将中国共产党描绘成孙中山革命事业最忠实的继承者，并认为已故领导人对国家统一的承诺支持了北京统一台湾的目标。
习近平将实现中国的“完全统一”描述为中国共产党的历史使命，宣称“历史的潮流不可阻挡”，统一“必须而且一定会实现”。
中山陵位于中国江苏省南京市。 CNA档案照片
他还重申北京对“一国两制”框架下“和平统一”的承诺，表示中国愿意就两岸关系和统一问题进行对话，同时坚称不会有“台独”的空间。
“一国两制”是北京在香港和澳门分别从英国和葡萄牙统治下移交后实施的框架，并为台湾提出的框架，但遭到台湾政府和大多数人民的拒绝。
陆委会在例行新闻发布会后发表声明，指责北京歪曲历史叙述，并利用孙中山的遗产来促进与台湾的统一。
该委员会表示：“如果中共真正想纪念孙中山，就应该承认他所创建的中华民国继续存在的客观事实。”并呼吁北京尊重台湾的民主生活方式并推行政治改革。
该委员会表示，中华民国从未被推翻或取代，中华民国和中华人民共和国都不从属于对方。
马克说：“中华人民共和国从未统治过台湾一天。”他认为北京无权对台湾实行统一或决定台湾的未来。
它还拒绝“一国两种制度”，称台湾的未来应由中华民国民主宪政制度下的2300万人民决定。
早些时候，陆委会副主任兼发言人梁文杰在吹风会上表示，习近平关于两岸统一的言论“与过去没有太大不同”。
