MAC urges Beijing to recognize ROC's existence after Xi's remarks - Focus Taiwan
MAC urges Beijing to recognize ROC's existence after Xi's remarks
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Chinese President Xi Jinping (center). CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Thursday urged Beijing to recognize the continued existence of the Republic of China (ROC) and respect Taiwan's democracy after Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) reiterated that unification with Taiwan was inevitable.
Xi made the remarks at a ceremony in Beijing marking what China calls the 160th anniversary of the birth of Sun Yat-sen (孫中山), who led the revolution that overthrew the Qing dynasty and established the ROC in 1912.
Sun is revered on both sides of the Taiwan Strait for his role in ending imperial rule. The ROC government, which retreated to Taiwan in 1949 after losing the Chinese Civil War, regards him as its founding father.
Opposition KMT holds a ceremony in honor of Sun Yat-sen. CNA file photo
The People's Republic of China (PRC), meanwhile, hails Sun as a pioneer of China's democratic revolution.
In his speech, Xi portrayed the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) as the most faithful successor to Sun's revolutionary cause, arguing that the late leader's commitment to national unity supported Beijing's goal of unification with Taiwan.
Xi described achieving China's "complete reunification" as a historical mission of the CCP, declaring that "the tide of history cannot be stopped" and that unification "must and will be achieved."
The Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. CNA file photo
He also reiterated Beijing's commitment to "peaceful reunification" under its "one country, two systems" framework, saying China was willing to hold talks on cross-strait relations and unification while insisting that there would be no room for Taiwan independence.
"One country, two systems" is a framework Beijing has implemented in Hong Kong and Macao following their handovers from British and Portuguese rule, respectively, and proposed for Taiwan, but both Taiwan's government and a majority of its people have rejected it.
In a statement issued after its regular news briefing, MAC accused Beijing of distorting historical narratives and using Sun's legacy to promote unification with Taiwan.
"If the CCP truly wishes to commemorate Sun Yat-sen, it should acknowledge the objective fact that the ROC he founded continues to exist," the council said, calling on Beijing to respect Taiwan's democratic way of life and pursue political reform.
The council said the ROC had never been overthrown or replaced, and that neither it nor the PRC was subordinate to the other.
"The PRC has never ruled Taiwan for a single day," MAC said, arguing that Beijing had no right to impose unification on Taiwan or determine its future.
It also rejected "one country, two systems," saying Taiwan's future should be decided by its 23 million people under the ROC's democratic constitutional system.
Earlier at the briefing, MAC deputy head and spokesperson Liang Wen-chieh (梁文傑) said Xi's remarks on unification with Taiwan were "not much different from the past."
Liang said the speech primarily sought to portray the CCP as the legitimate successor to Sun's revolutionary ideals and bolster the legitimacy of CCP rule and Xi's political ideology.
While Beijing described Thursday's event as marking Sun's 160th birth anniversary, Taiwan's government marked Sun's 160th birth anniversary last year and considers 2026 his 161st, following a traditional counting system that treats the year of birth as the first year.

法国参议员向台湾澎湖寻求缓解马约特岛水资源短缺的方法 - 聚焦台湾
采访/法国参议员向台湾澎湖寻求缓解马约特岛水资源短缺的方法
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
代表马约特岛的法国参议员塔尼·穆罕默德·索利希。中央通讯社照片2026年11月12日
中新社台北11月12日电 代表马约特岛的法国参议员周二表示，这个印度洋岛国可以借鉴台湾在海水淡化和废水再利用方面的经验，以缓解导致多年配给的水资源短缺问题。
萨尼·穆罕默德·索利希在台北接受中央社采访时表示，他的代表团在11月6日参观了澎湖县的海水淡化厂和双湖源废水回收设施后，向台湾同行询问了双方如何合作。
“水对马约特岛来说绝对至关重要，”穆罕默德·索利希说。 “我们的饮用水多年来一直实行配给制。我们依靠雨水，我们将雨水收集在水库中并全年储存。”
马约特岛是法国海外省，位于马达加斯加和非洲大陆之间的莫桑比克海峡，有一座海水淡化厂正在运营。 Ironi Bé 的第二个项目在法院于 7 月暂停其环境许可证后面临延误。
穆罕默德·索利希表示，下一步可能是让台湾专家访问马约特岛，评估当地情况，看看他们能提供什么帮助。
他表示，希望合作从教育开始。台湾外交部副部长吴志中表示，曾建议马约特岛学生赴台升学，并表示代表团回国后将迅速物色候选人。
据台湾外交部称，11月5日至10日的这次访问是马约特岛官方代表团的首次访问。吴邦国7月27日至29日率团访问马约特岛后，该代表团由当地官员和企业代表组成的11人小组前往台湾。

他说：“由于其地理位置，马约特岛可以成为任何希望与我们合作的伙伴的经济和技术合作中心。”

Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) A French senator representing Mayotte said Tuesday that the Indian Ocean island could draw on Taiwan's experience with seawater desalination and wastewater reuse to ease water shortages that have led to years of rationing.
In an interview with CNA in Taipei, Thani Mohamed Soilihi said he had asked Taiwanese counterparts how the two sides could work together after his delegation toured a desalination plant and the Shuanghuyuan wastewater recycling facility in Penghu County on Nov. 6.
"Water is absolutely crucial for Mayotte," Mohamed Soilihi said. "Our drinking water has been rationed for several years. We rely on rainwater, which we collect in reservoirs and store throughout the year."
Mayotte, a French overseas department in the Mozambique Channel between Madagascar and mainland Africa, has one desalination plant in operation. A second project, at Ironi Bé, faces delays after a court suspended its environmental permit in July.
Mohamed Soilihi said a possible next step would be for Taiwanese specialists to visit Mayotte to assess local conditions and see how they could help.
He said he expected cooperation to begin with education. Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister François Wu (吳志中) had suggested that students from Mayotte pursue their studies in Taiwan, he said, adding that the delegation would move quickly to identify candidates after returning home.
The Nov. 5-10 trip was the first by an official delegation from Mayotte, according to Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The 11-member group included local officials and business representatives and traveled to Taiwan after Wu led a delegation to Mayotte from July 27 to 29.
The trip was Mohamed Soilihi's third to Taiwan, following visits in December 2019 and April 2026. He called an unscheduled encounter with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) "the icing on the cake," saying Lai stopped to greet the group and gave its members a chance to tell him about Mayotte.
Mohamed Soilihi said he was seeking partnerships on behalf of Mayotte's local authorities and pointed to marine habitat restoration and disaster preparedness as other areas where the two sides could share expertise.
"Because of its geographic position, Mayotte can be a hub for economic and technical cooperation for any partner that wants to work with us," he said.

MAC不确定台湾是否收到美国有关英伟达中国间谍的警告
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
图片来自Pixabay，仅供说明之用
中新社台北11月12日电 台湾最高对华政策机构周四表示，尚未收到有关美国建议监视与英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋有关的涉嫌中国间谍的信息，但无法确认其他机构是否已收到警报。
陆委会副主任兼发言人梁文杰在台北举行的例行新闻发布会上表示，《纽约时报》周二发表的报道称，华盛顿建议台湾当局在2024年监视黄乐的访问，他无法证实这一报道。
梁在回答中央社记者提问时表示：“MAC确实从未收到过此类信息。”
当被问及其他台湾政府机构是否可能收到这些情报时，梁说，陆委会不是情报机构。
“我们不确定其他机构是否收到了它，”他说。
与新加坡云计算公司 Megaspeed 有联系的中国女商人爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 因有报道称美国情报官员怀疑她为中国从事间谍活动以及她与英伟达创始人有恋爱关系而受到密切关注。
周四，台湾人民党立委许忠信（右）在台北举行的立法院委员会听证会上，就黄丽娟访台一事向陆委会官员提问。中央通讯社照片2026年11月12日
周四早些时候，陆委会主席邱垂正告诉立法会议员，黄丽娟在2024年3次进入台湾，2025年5次进入台湾，今年没有记录访问记录。
邱说，她以香港居民身份出于商业目的进入台湾，在这些访问期间没有被特别标记。
梁在吹风会上表示，台湾对来自中国大陆、香港和澳门的游客进行筛查，当情报或其他线索表明存在潜在安全风险时，会加强审查。
他说，如果没有这些信息，申请人通常会接受例行筛选。
梁还表示，陆委会既无法证实也无法否认针对黄爱丽的间谍指控，也没有具体说明台湾当局何时首次意识到她的潜在安全问题。
大陆委员会发言人梁文杰周四表示。中央通讯社照片2026年11月12日
另外，行政院发言人李慧芝周四在内阁会议后的新闻发布会上表示，此案涉及跨境合作调查，但以正在进行的调查的机密性为由拒绝透露细节。
入出国及移民署官员林贻俊表示，入出国及移民署已与国安机关合作，对黄丽娟访台进行监控。
林说，她的入境许可证已被吊销，并受到入境限制。
据《纽约时报》报道，Alice Huang 与 Megaspeed 在美国对中国出口限制期间收购先进的 Nvidia 人工智能芯片有关。
黄仁勋承认自己有婚外情，但没有公开透露涉案女子的身份。媒体报道称他与黄爱丽有恋情。
中国外交部驳斥了有关间谍活动的指控，称其毫无根据。

MAC not sure if Taiwan received U.S. warning about Nvidia China spy
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Image from Pixabay for illustrative purpose only
Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Taiwan's top China policy agency said Thursday it had received no information about a reported U.S. recommendation to monitor a suspected Chinese spy linked to Nvidia Corp. CEO Jensen Huang (黃仁勳), but could not confirm whether other agencies had been alerted.
At a regular news briefing in Taipei, Liang Wen-chieh (梁文傑), deputy head and spokesperson of the Mainland Affairs Council (MAC), said he could not verify a New York Times report published Tuesday that Washington had advised Taiwanese authorities in 2024 to monitor visits by Alice Huang (黃樂).
"MAC has indeed never received such information," Liang said in response to a CNA question.
Asked whether other Taiwanese government agencies might have received the intelligence, Liang said MAC was not an intelligence agency.
"We are not sure whether other agencies received it," he said.
Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman linked to Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed, has come under scrutiny following reports that U.S. intelligence officials suspected her of spying for China and that she had a romantic relationship with the Nvidia founder.
Taiwan People's Party Legislator Hsu Chung-hsin (right) questions Mainland Affairs Council officials about Alice Huang's visits to Taiwan during a Legislative Yuan committee hearing in Taipei on Thursday. CNA photo Nov. 12, 2026
Earlier Thursday, MAC head Chiu Chui-cheng (邱垂正) told lawmakers that Alice Huang had entered Taiwan three times in 2024 and five times in 2025, with no recorded visits this year.
She entered Taiwan as a Hong Kong resident for business purposes and had not been specially flagged during those visits, Chiu said.
At the briefing, Liang said Taiwan screens visitors from China, Hong Kong and Macao, with heightened scrutiny applied when intelligence or other leads indicate potential security risks.
Without such information, applicants generally undergo routine screening, he said.
Liang also said MAC could neither confirm nor deny the espionage allegations against Alice Huang and did not specify when Taiwanese authorities first became aware of potential security concerns about her.
Mainland Affairs Council spokesman Liang Wen-chieh on Thursday. CNA photo Nov. 12, 2026
Separately, Executive Yuan spokesperson Michelle Lee (李慧芝) said at a post-Cabinet meeting news conference Thursday that the case involved a cross-border cooperative investigation, but declined to disclose details, citing the confidentiality of ongoing investigations.
National Immigration Agency official Lin Yi-jun (林貽俊) said the agency had worked with national security authorities to monitor Alice Huang's visits to Taiwan.
Her entry permit has since been revoked, and she has been placed under entry restrictions, Lin said.
According to the New York Times, Alice Huang was linked to Megaspeed's acquisition of advanced Nvidia artificial intelligence chips amid U.S. export restrictions on China.
Jensen Huang has acknowledged having an extramarital affair without publicly identifying the woman involved. Media reports have linked him romantically to Alice Huang.
China's Foreign Ministry has dismissed the espionage allegations as groundless.

summary: Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋为何辞职，Colette Kress 是谁？ |商业和经济新闻|英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋为何辞职？科莱特·克雷斯是谁？在社交媒体上 视频时长 15 分 43 秒 play-arrow15:43 由于事务引发安全担忧，黄仁勋辞去 Nvidia 首席执行官职务 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋在被曝有两次婚外情后辞职。英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 已接任临时首席执行官，同时该公司正在寻找永久替代者。 2Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋的步骤清单 1
content:
Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋为何辞职，Colette Kress 是谁？ |商业和经济新闻|半岛电视台
分享 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋为何辞职？Colette Kress 是谁？在社交媒体上
视频时长 15 分 43 秒 play-arrow15:43
由于事件引发安全担忧，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因两次婚外情被曝光而辞职。
英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 已接任临时首席执行官，同时该公司正在寻找永久替代者。
名单1 2Nvidia CEO黄仁勋卸任，更多事务细节曝光
list 2 of 2特朗普因英伟达丑闻而前往中国：他会对北京采取更强硬的态度吗？
该公司控制着先进人工智能 (AI) 芯片估计 90% 的市场，是世界上最有价值的公司之一。
经过几天对其个人关系和潜在国家安全问题的严格审查后，黄于周四辞职。
周日，黄承认对妻子不忠，并向家人和英伟达员工道歉。
黄小时候从台湾移居美国。在他 1993 年共同创立 Nvidia 之前，他的妻子 Lori 就一直陪伴在他身边。
英伟达董事会最初支持黄仁勋，周日表示对他的领导能力充满信心。它还对有关他成为中国情报部门目标的报道展开了独立调查。
但周三，路透社报道称，在与直接向他汇报的英伟达高级高管金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)的关系进一步曝光后，董事会正在开会考虑是否将他免职。
该公司周四宣布辞职。黄仁勋还辞去董事会职务，结束了他 33 年的首席执行官任期。
英伟达没有给出他离职的原因。
董事会在一份声明中表示，“詹森对英伟达的贡献是深远的”，并感谢他“对公司和行业做出的不可估量的贡献”。
黄仁勋受到哪些指控？
这些指控与报道的婚外情有关。
第一起案件涉及新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang，据称她曾为中国情报部门工作。
这些指控引发了对国家安全的质疑，特别是考虑到黄仁勋支持允许英伟达向中国出售先进的人工智能芯片。
另外，《纽约时报》周三报道称，黄与直接向他汇报的英伟达医疗保健副总裁鲍威尔有染。
第二个报道的关系引发了对涉及高级管理人员的潜在利益冲突的担忧。
为什么会出现国家安全问题？
此次争议发生之际，华盛顿正就向中国出口先进的美国人工智能芯片展开辩论。
63 岁的黄仁勋多年来一直致力于反对限制 Nvidia 芯片向中国销售。
2025 年 12 月，唐纳德·特朗普总统批准向中国出口 Nvidia 的 H200 芯片，尽管担心该技术可能会增强北京的人工智能能力。
这些芯片的性能大约是中国买家之前购买的 H20 型号的六倍。
出口产品须接受美国检查、运输限制、军事用途限制以及 25% 的关税。
据半岛电视台的 Osama Bin Javaid 报道，据报道，中国公司订购了超过 200 万个 H200 芯片，可能价值 100 万美元。

【原文 English Original】
Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress? | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera
Share Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress? on social media
Video Duration 15 minutes 43 seconds play-arrow15:43
Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO as affairs raise security concerns
Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned following revelations that he had two extramarital affairs.
Nvidia’s chief financial officer, Colette Kress, has taken over as interim CEO while the company looks for a permanent replacement.
list 1 of 2Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down, more affair details revealed
list 2 of 2Trump heads to China amid Nvidia scandal: Will he get tougher on Beijing?
The company controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips and is one of the world’s most valuable companies.
Huang stepped down on Thursday following several days of intense scrutiny over his personal relationships and potential national security issues.
On Sunday, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and apologised to his family and to Nvidia employees.
Huang moved to the United States from Taiwan as a child. His wife, Lori, has been with him since before he cofounded Nvidia in 1993.
Nvidia’s board initially backed Huang, saying on Sunday that it had confidence in his leadership. It also launched an independent investigation into reports that he had been targeted by Chinese intelligence.
But on Wednesday, the Reuters news agency reported the board was meeting to consider whether to remove him following further revelations of a relationship with Kimberly Powell, a senior Nvidia executive who reported directly to him.
The company announced his resignation on Thursday. Huang also resigned from the board, ending his 33-year tenure as chief executive.
Nvidia didn’t give a reason for his departure.
“Jensen’s contributions to Nvidia are profound,” the board said in a statement, thanking him for his “immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry”.
What are the allegations involving Jensen Huang?
The allegations were related to reported extramarital affairs.
The first involved Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based tech company Megaspeed, who is alleged to have worked for Chinese intelligence.
The allegations have raised questions about national security, particularly given Huang’s support for allowing Nvidia to sell advanced AI chips to China.
Separately, The New York Times reported on Wednesday that Huang had an affair with Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, who reported directly to him.
The second reported relationship raised concerns about a potential conflict of interest involving a senior executive.
Why are there national security concerns?
The controversy comes amid a debate in Washington over exporting advanced US AI chips to China.
Huang, 63, spent years campaigning against the restrictions on Nvidia chip sales to China.
In December 2025, President Donald Trump approved the export of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China, despite concerns that the technology could bolster Beijing’s AI capabilities.
The chips are about six times more powerful than the H20 models previously available to Chinese buyers.
Exports are subject to US inspections, limits on shipments, restrictions on military use and a 25 percent tariff.
According to Al Jazeera’s Osama Bin Javaid, Chinese companies reportedly ordered more than two million H200 chips, potentially worth $54bn.
“Worth remembering it’s orders, not completed sales,” he said.
Critics are concerned the technology could help China close the AI gap with the US.
The allegations raised questions about whether his personal relationships could have exposed sensitive information.
“There is no established evidence he knowingly assisted Beijing or that company secrets were compromised,” Bin Javaid noted.
Nvidia’s board has also said it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.
Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
Kress has served as Nvidia’s chief financial officer since September 2013 and oversaw the chipmaker’s finances during a period of growth.
During her time at Nvidia, the company’s annual revenue rose from $4.13bn in fiscal 2014 to $215.9bn in fiscal 2026.
Before joining Nvidia, Kress held senior finance roles at Texas Instruments, Microsoft and Cisco.
She holds a bachelor’s degree in finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.
Kress is also among America’s wealthiest self-made women, according to Forbes.
In a statement following her appointment, Kress said she was committed to building on the foundation Huang had created over the past 33 years.
This undated handout photo from Nvidia obtained on November 12, 2026, shows Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, who has been named interim CEO following the resignation of Jensen Huang [Handout/Nvidia via AFP]
Will Colette Kress become Nvidia’s permanent CEO?
Nvidia’s board has appointed Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement and considers both internal and external candidates.
Trump has suggested former Apple chief executive Tim Cook as Huang’s successor.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump praised Huang’s work at Nvidia and said Cook was the person to replace him.
“A Legend replaces a Legend,” Trump wrote.
Cook stepped down as Apple’s chief executive in September and now serves as the company’s executive chairman.
Speaking to Al Jazeera, technology and cybersecurity analyst Ritesh Kotak said choosing Nvidia’s next CEO would be a decision for the company’s board.
“At the end of the day, it comes down to the board,” he said.
Kotak pointed to the differences between Apple, which primarily sells consumer technology, and Nvidia, whose chips power much of the AI industry.
There has been no indication that Cook is interested in the position.
Trump has defended Huang amid the allegations.
Reporting from the White House, Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher said Trump had offered a “very forceful defence” of the Nvidia founder, who accompanied him on a trip to China earlier this year.
Trump said he recently learned of the suspected spying scandal, although reports suggest he had been informed of the allegations before the trip.
Fisher said the president was likely to face further questions about “what he knew and when he knew it”.
Meanwhile, Huang’s departure has raised concerns about Nvidia’s future.
“He’s the captain that was steering the ship back since the early 90s,” Kotak told Al Jazeera.
“These are big shoes that need to be filled,” he added.
Kotak said the resignation could create uncertainty among Nvidia’s employees and customers.
“If you’re Nvidia, if you’re the employees, if you’re a customer, I think you’re worried right now,” he said.
Clement Delangue, chief executive of Hugging Face, which Nvidia has agreed to acquire, reaffirmed his commitment to open-source AI following Huang’s resignation.
Meanwhile, Lloyd Blankfein, former chief executive of Goldman Sachs, reflected on Huang’s departure in a post on X.
“Sad about Jensen. Shakespearean,” he wrote, quoting former French President Charles de Gaulle: “The graveyards are filled with indispensable men.”
Huang’s departure has also raised questions about the wider AI industry. Nvidia is not only a major chip supplier but also an investor in companies that build and rent out AI computing infrastructure.
The company is also preparing to invest approximately $10bn in AI developer Anthropic as part of its planned stock market listing, expected next week.

summary: 巴布亚新几内亚突然驱逐台湾外交官背后的中国压力：外交部 - 聚焦台湾 巴布亚新几内亚突然驱逐台湾外交官背后的中国压力：外交部 要激活文本转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。中新社台北11月12日电 台湾外交部官员周四表示，中国是巴布亚新几内亚上周突然决定驱逐台湾外交官并要求关闭台湾驻台代表处的幕后黑手。巴布亚新几内亚外长贾斯汀·特卡琴科于7月16日首次提出关闭台湾代表处的要求
content:
巴布亚新几内亚突然驱逐台湾外交官背后的中国压力：外交部 - 聚焦台湾
巴布亚新几内亚突然驱逐台湾外交官背后的中国压力：外交部
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月12日电 台湾外交部官员周四表示，中国是巴布亚新几内亚上周突然决定驱逐台湾外交官并要求关闭台湾驻台代表处的幕后黑手。
外交部东亚司副司长林宏勋表示，巴布亚新几内亚外长特卡琴科于7月16日首次提出关闭台湾代表处的要求，理由是巴布亚新几内亚坚持“一个中国”政策。
林在立法听证会上表示，台湾和巴布亚新几内亚随后就此事进行了谈判，并同意巴布亚新几内亚将提前一年书面通知台湾关闭代表处。
但11月6日，巴布亚新几内亚再次提出这一问题，要求台湾驻巴外交官在7天内离境。
外交部副部长陈明琪也在立法听证会上回答问题时表示，他相信巴布亚新几内亚的转变是受到来自中国的压力推动的。
立法院研究及国防委员会12日邀请外交部政务次长陈明祺（后中）就「我国参与国际组织近况与工作重点」进行报告，列主席并备质询。中央社记者赵世勋摄115年11月12日
他指出，巴新高层代表团上周刚刚访华，巴新总理马拉佩也定于下周赴华出席亚太经合组织峰会。
“鉴于这些情况，我们的评估是巴布亚新几内亚政府可能受到了来自中国的巨大压力，甚至提供了经济激励，”陈说。
例如，陈说，在巴布亚新几内亚要求关闭台湾代表处后，台湾决定停止从巴布亚新几内亚购买液化天然气，中国已宣布准备增加从巴布亚新几内亚进口液化天然气。
陈和林正在回答立法者关于关闭台湾经济办公室的问题，该机构于 1990 年在巴布亚新几内亚莫尔兹比港首次设立。
11月6日，巴布亚新几内亚外交部表示，外交部秘书埃利亚斯·沃亨古已通知台湾经济办公室主任邱陈钰7天内离境。
该部门在一份声明中表示，为期 7 天的通知也适用于该办公室的一等秘书 Lee Chung-nun，而剩下的一名外交官潘绍均将被允许留下来监督该办公室在一年内关闭。
该部门还表示，10月6日已向台湾发出12个月的通知，以完成办事处的关闭。
该部门表示：“这不应被解释为保证所有现有人员配置和运营安排在此期间保持不变。”
对此，台湾外交部当天宣布关闭该办事处并撤回所有驻守人员。
外交部还表示，将“考虑到国家尊严、外交自主和国家整体利益”，对台湾与巴布亚新几内亚的关系进行全面审查和调整。
据外交部称，此后，台湾一直从巴布亚新几内亚撤出其外交和技术使团人员。
巴布亚新几内亚是中国的外交盟友，中国不允许其盟友同时保持外交关系

China pressure behind PNG's abrupt expulsion of Taiwan diplomats: MOFA
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Taiwan foreign ministry officials said Thursday that China was behind Papua New Guinea's (PNG) sudden decision last week to expel Taiwanese diplomats and demand the closure of the Taiwan representative office there.
PNG Foreign Minister Justin Tkatchenko first made the demand on July 16 for the closure of the Taiwan representative office, citing his country's adherence to the "one-China" policy, said Lin Hung-hsun (林宏勳), deputy director-general of the foreign ministry's Department of East Asian and Pacific Affairs.
Taiwan and PNG subsequently engaged in talks over the matter, and it was agreed that PNG would give Taiwan one year's written notice to close the representative office, Lin said during a legislative hearing.
However, on Nov. 6, PNG raised the issue again, demanding that Taiwanese diplomats there leave the country within seven days, he said.
Also answering questions at the legislative hearing, Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi (陳明祺) said he believed PNG's about-turn was driven by pressure from China.
立法院外交及國防委員會12日邀請外交部政務次長陳明祺（後中）就「我國參與國際組織近況與工作重點」進行報告，列席並備質詢。中央社記者趙世勳攝 115年11月12日
He pointed out that a high-level PNG delegation had visited China just last week, while PNG Prime Minister James Marape is scheduled to travel to China next week to attend the APEC summit.
"Given these circumstances, our assessment is that the government of Papua New Guinea may have been subjected to significant pressure from China or even offered economic incentives," Chen said.
For instance, China has announced that it stands ready to increase its imports of liquefied natural gas (LNG) from PNG, following Taiwan's decision to stop purchasing LNG from the Pacific nation after PNG demanded the closure of the Taiwan representative office there, Chen said.
Chen and Lin were answering lawmakers' questions about the closure of the Taiwan Economic Office, as it was named, which was first opened in 1990 in Port Moresby, PNG.
On Nov. 6, PNG's Department of Foreign Affairs said its secretary, Elias Wohengu, had given notice to the head of the Taiwan Economic Office Chiu Chen-yu (邱陳煜) to leave the country within seven days.
The seven-day notice also applied to the office's First Secretary Lee Chung-nun, while the one remaining diplomat, Pan Shao-jyun, would be allowed to stay to oversee the office's closure within a year, the department said in a statement.
The department also said that on Oct. 6, it had given Taiwan 12 months' notice to complete the closure of the office.
"It should not be interpreted as an assurance that all existing staffing and operational arrangements will remain unchanged throughout that period," the department said.
In response, Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) announced the same day that it would close the office and withdraw all personnel stationed there.
MOFA also said it would conduct a comprehensive review and adjustment of Taiwan's ties with PNG, "in consideration of national dignity, diplomatic autonomy, and overall national interests."
Since then, Taiwan has been withdrawing its diplomatic and technical mission personnel from PNG, according to MOFA.
PNG is a diplomatic ally of China, which does not permit its allies to maintain simultaneous diplomatic relations with Taiwan.

title: 5 Zimbabwe: 'Why Is Zimbabwe Paying Double?' - MP Demands Probe Into High Cement, Fertiliser Prices
summary: Zimbabwe: 'Why Is Zimbabwe Paying Double?' - MP Demands Probe Into High Cement, Fertiliser Prices - allAfrica.com Zimbabwe: 'Why Is Zimbabwe Paying Double?' - MP Demands Probe Into High Cement, Fertiliser Prices ZANU PF Chief Whip and Gutu
content:
Zimbabwe: 'Why Is Zimbabwe Paying Double?' - MP Demands Probe Into High Cement, Fertiliser Prices - allAfrica.com
Zimbabwe: 'Why Is Zimbabwe Paying Double?' - MP Demands Probe Into High Cement, Fertiliser Prices
ZANU PF Chief Whip and Gutu South legislator Pupurai Togarepi has called for an investigation into the high cost of cement and fertiliser in Zimbabwe, saying local consumers are paying almost double the prices charged in neighbouring countries.
Raising the matter as a point of national interest in Parliament on Tuesday, Togarepi called on Industry and Commerce Minister Nqobizitha Mangaliso Ndlovu to issue a ministerial statement explaining the significant price disparities along the local supply chain.
However, Speaker of Parliament Advocate Jacob Mudenda waived the request for an immediate ministerial statement.
Togarepi insisted that the issue required urgent attention, questioning why Zimbabweans were paying substantially more for essential agricultural inputs than consumers elsewhere in the region.
Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines
"In the region, a bag of fertiliser is about US$25. In Zimbabwe today, that same bag is US$50," Togarepi said.
"So the difference, I do not understand why we have this. Is it cost-sharing? Are these people carrying costs that we don't know?"
The legislator said Zimbabwe previously enjoyed competitive fertiliser prices compared to other countries in the region and internationally, questioning how local farmers could remain profitable under the current cost structure.
"How do our people produce? We already have a high cost of production," he said.
He added that the price disparities were forcing Zimbabweans to source agricultural inputs from neighbouring countries despite the additional logistical expenses.
"That is why we have seen people buying from other countries. Why are they giving us competitive prices to save our people?" he asked.
Togarepi urged Parliament's Portfolio Committee on Industry and Commerce to investigate the entire value chain, including production, imports and distribution, to establish the factors behind the price differences.
He argued that even if Zimbabwe imported fertiliser from neighbouring countries, the products would remain cheaper than those available locally.
"I don't know how we can be helped by this Industry Committee if we cannot go to this place and put in our portfolio committee for Industry and Commerce for us to know the justification of these disparities. They are huge," he said.
The MP also raised concern over the cost of cement, saying prices had become increasingly unaffordable for ordinary Zimbabweans seeking to build homes.

content:
2026年8月16日，在北京，一名快递员在三轮摩托车上查看手机。
包括外卖员、快递员在内的中国新就业群体，将被首次列入中国共产党第二十一次大全国代表大会代表的构成范围。这个拥有数以千万从业员的群体近年来越发引起官方高度重视。中共中央是基于什么考量，把他们纳入党代表选荐范围呢？
中共中央日前发出《通知》，为明年召开的党代会、领导层五年一次换届做准备。《通知》明确提出，二十一大代表2,360个名额必须涵盖经济、科技、国防、政法、教育、宣传、文化、卫生、体育、社会管理和新就业群体等各方代表。
“新就业群体”首次纳入代表构成范围，引起外界关注和热议。
根据中国人社部的官方定义，“新就业群体”指的是依托网路平台承接任务、获取报酬，用工关系灵活多样的劳动者。根据“中华全国总工会”2023年进行的调查显示，当年中国的新就业形态劳动者达到8,400万人，占职工总数约两成。
国际组织“中国劳工观察”创始人李强对美国之音表示，这个群体的从业人员普遍待遇微薄，而且长期备受社会漠视。
李强说：“现在都是十几个小时一天，一周工作七天，十几天都没有休息，所谓的‘灵活就业’并不是轻松就业，是艰苦就业。”
他解释说，一般来说，送餐平台的工资也就是最低工资，可能一个月也就四五千块钱，平台还不一定帮这些人缴纳社保。这些新就业群体的生活是没有保障的，就维持一个基本的生活。
随着中国经济持续不振，外资持续撤离，传统制造业和白领岗位收缩，大量失业人员涌入外卖和网约车等行业，这个群体可能还有继续扩大的趋势。
美国的独立时评人蔡慎坤指出，这个群体与中国人的日常生活息息相关。他在接受美国之音采访时说：“就业市场非常严峻。所谓的‘新就业群体’就是‘灵活就业’，包括开物流车、开‘滴滴车’、送外卖、网上直播。所谓的新媒体、跨境电商实际上都属于‘新就业群体’。”
李强说，这个群体是整个社会最忽视的群体。“肯定是觉得分配不平，肯定是不满。”
独立时评人蔡慎坤相信，中共把新就业群体纳入二十一大，目的是加强对他们的控制，防范潜在政治风险。
蔡慎坤说：“他们(新就业群体)涉及到社会的最底层。他们知道这个社会的真实状况。他们知道这个社会现在到底出了什么问题。要是他们像导火索一样被点燃的话，很容易引发反应。比方说他们遭到不公平的待遇，他们受到欺负，就有可能会发出不同的声音。”
他说，官方在这个群体中找到他们的代表，是想表达“我们还是很尊重你们的。你们可以通过正常的方式来发出你们不同的声音”。
新就业群体也早已引起官方的关注。中国国家主席习近平多次就这个群体的生活公开表态。2020年疫情期间，习近平曾就外卖员被平台抽成、快递员工作压力大等情况，发表回应。今年春节，习近平到北京西城区看望休息站的快递员，并叮嘱当局要“关心他们的生活”。
中共中央办公厅、中国国务院办公厅去年曾发文，强调要对涉及逾8000万人的新就业群体加强思想政治引领，引导他们“听党话、跟党走”。
位于华盛顿的非政府组织自由之家(Freedom House)11月2日曾公布了2026年6月到9月中国各地的抗议活动的数据。根据最新数据，第三季度，中国共发生948起抗议活动，其中工人主导的抗议活动比例最高。
不过，国际组织“中国劳工观察”创始人李强认为，官方给予他们政治确认，恐怕只具备象征意义。
李强说：“党代会也就是一个橡皮章。就算他们这些人进了21大，也是不可能发言的。党代会也讨论不出什么东西，就算是需要制定政策，可能都是党已经制定好了。”
李强估计，中共希望透过把新就业群体纳入二十一大，向企业发出改善职工待遇的讯息，但问题是，官方在制定劳工政策时不能光考虑到劳方的利益。
李强说：“可能是让这些平台把部分利润分配给工人，可是，外卖群体的工人待遇有所改善的话，这些外卖平台公司的利润就会受影响。中国共产党想要去改善这个群体(的待遇)，也许只是想作出姿态。”
他说，要确定是否只是象征意义，以后可以关注中国劳动法的执行会否规范化，外卖人员的工作时间会否有所压缩，工资、福利会否增加等。

# 台湾参与跨国合作调查英伟达疑似中国谍案 女主黄乐曾8次访台 已被禁止入境

据中央社台北12日消息，疑为中国间谍的中国籍女商人黄乐（Alice Huang）曾8次持香港护照访台，台湾行政院表示，相关个案侦办正在进行中，细节不便说明，且涉及“跨国合作调查”，目前无更多资讯提供。

发表时间： 12/11/2026 - 19:19

 4 分钟 浏览时间

 2026年11月9日获得的CTI视频画面截图显示，一名经路透社与另行获取的照片比对后确认名为Alice Huang的女子，于2025年5月22日在台湾台北的一家餐厅与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（身着黑色服装）共进晚餐。 via REUTERS - CTI

 作者： [古莉](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%8F%A4%E8%8E%89/ "古莉")

广告

继续浏览后续

台湾行政院发言人李慧芝12在记者会说明，此个案是否有犯罪嫌疑以及相关调查程序等，目前都未有公开资讯，因为犯罪涉及侦查不公开，个案没有多余说明，且案子涉及跨国合作调查部分，目前无更多资讯提供。

台湾陆委会主委邱垂正（Chiu Chui-cheng）周四表示，被指控在与英伟达（Nvidia）掌门人保持婚外情期间为北京效力的中国女子爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang），在2024年至2025年间曾八次入境台湾，2024年入境三次，2025年五次，今年（2026年）尚无入境记录。

此前《纽约时报》曾报道称，美国早在2024年就建议台湾方面监控爱丽丝·黄的行踪，邱垂正是在回应立委就此提出的质询时作出的上述表态。

台湾内政部长刘世芳与移民署长林宏恩11日在立法院表示，对黄乐入出境资料全程均有掌握，目前已废除黄乐的签证、禁止她再度入境台湾。

至于如何防范中国人士利用香港身分或商务事由在台湾从事间谍活动，台湾行政院发言人李慧芝说，国安单位透过联防机制，在中国人士以商务等事由提出来台申请时，就会启动陆委会与国安单位的联合审查，且依据情资对已入境者进行事中访视。

summary: 路透社星期三(11月11日)报道说，一所与中国人民解放军关系密切的中国高校10月份购入了英伟达(Nvidia)性能强大的H200先进芯片，这凸显了美国在限制中国获取先进技术方面存在漏洞。 路透社在这篇独家报道中披露，根据中国西北工业大学官网10月21日发布的一份采购记录，该校上个月购入了2枚H200芯片，总价为87.47万元人民币(约合12.3万美元)。 报道称，采购记录显示，这些芯片并非直接从英伟达购入，而是由该校管理学院通过一家位于陕西西安市的企业--陕西博算网络科技有限
content:
路透社星期三(11月11日)报道说，一所与中国人民解放军关系密切的中国高校10月份购入了英伟达(Nvidia)性能强大的H200先进芯片，这凸显了美国在限制中国获取先进技术方面存在漏洞。
路透社在这篇独家报道中披露，根据中国西北工业大学官网10月21日发布的一份采购记录，该校上个月购入了2枚H200芯片，总价为87.47万元人民币(约合12.3万美元)。
报道称，采购记录显示，这些芯片并非直接从英伟达购入，而是由该校管理学院通过一家位于陕西西安市的企业--陕西博算网络科技有限公司进行采购的。
美国之音记者在西北工业大学官网搜索，发现所有相关新闻页面已经消失了。
西北工业大学属于中国知名的“国防七校”(即工信部直属七所国防类重点高校)之一。作为中国顶尖的国防工业依托高校，该校长期深度参与中国人民解放军及各大国防工业集团在军事方面的科研工作。
西北工业大学从2001年起，便一直位列美国商务部的“实体清单”(Entity List)制裁名单上，该名单限制美国企业向其出口受管制的商品与技术。
H200是英伟达公司用于训练和运行先进超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)系统的最强芯片之一，其出口受到美国的出口管制；特别对于像西北工业大学这种被列入制裁名单的机构，此类出口许可通常无法通过。
路透社的报道称，西北工业大学在位列美国出口管制“黑名单”时，仍可以完成此类采购，凸显了美国在限制中国获取先进技术方面存在漏洞。
今年1月，美国政府调整了英伟达H200的对华出口政策，开始允许符合条件的部分交易按个案申请许可；但该政策并未解除针对“实体清单”所列机构(如西北工业大学)的各项限制。
路透社还报道，采购记录显示，今年西北工业大学与多家中国本土科技供应商签订了五份算力租赁合同，从而得以使用H200芯片及英伟达其它高性能人工智能处理器。
近日，多个报道称英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)曾成为外国情报机构目标。这些报道指称黄仁勋与一位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的商界女性存在关联，而美国官员认定该女子为中国的情报人员。此消息在美国高科技业界及美国社会引发强烈关注。
黄仁勋一直在游说华盛顿放宽对华人工智能芯片销售限制。他曾主张，美国应继续向中国销售符合安全要求的产品，因为这既能维持美国的技术领先地位，也能确保中国客户持续依赖美国技术，而不会加快转向本土替代技术。
但是，黄仁勋的主张与一些美国国会议员的立场存在重大分歧。这些议员担心中国在获取英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片后，可能会加速人工智能系统开发与美国抗衡。
由于黄仁勋曾成为外国情报机构目标一事可能涉及美国国安问题，美国国会领导众议院外交委员会、常设情报委员会和中国问题特设委员会的共和党众议员布莱恩·马斯特(Brian Mast)、埃里克·“里克”·克劳福德(Eric “Rick” Crawford)和约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)要求黄仁勋在11月18日到国会，就此事进行说明。
在一封11月4日发给黄仁勋的信函中，三位议员写道：“至关重要的是，国会必须确定美国国家安全所面临的风险程度。”
现任众议院议长、共和党人麦克·约翰逊(Mike Johnson)星期二对美国媒体《政客》(Politico)表示，他支持把加强芯片出口管控的内容纳入年底的《国防授权法案》。
明年1月即将掌握参众两院控制权的民主党人也推动把限制对华出口芯片的立法条文纳入《国防授权法案》。
另外，11月5日，路透社援引知情人士的说法，大约有60万枚英伟达H200芯片，由于北京尚未批准进口，目前仍存放在香港，等待被运往中国。
美国之音就西工大购买英伟达先进芯片一事向美国商务部和国务院发出置评请求，截至发稿，尚未收到回应。

選戰進入倒數階段，民進黨台北市長候選人沈伯洋競選總部12日舉行第3次擴大選務會議，競辦總幹事吳思瑤（前排左2）會後接受聯訪，說明會中情形。中央社記者王揚宇攝 115年11月12日
（中央社記者王揚宇台北12日電）選舉投票日逼近，民進黨「台北隊」今天召開第3次擴大選務會議。民進黨台北市長候選人沈伯洋競選辦公室總幹事吳思瑤會後表示，最後階段有四大工作要務，包括全面強化陸戰，也要用行動實踐「戒慎恐懼」，強化支持者的固票、催票行動力，更要即時闢謠以及全力監票。
吳思瑤接受媒體聯訪表示，台北市議員及議員參選人今天會議全員到齊，是史上最團結的台北隊；會議聚焦選前工作要務，可分為4大項。
吳思瑤指出，台北市長蔣萬安是現任市長，擁有豐沛的現任優勢及資源，因此在基層組織上，必須全力固守、強化陸戰、固守組織，這是首要任務。
吳思瑤說，第二，「戒慎恐懼」不是嘴巴上說的，而是要去行動及實踐，因此要強化支持者的固票、催票、拉票行動力。第三，最後關鍵10幾天，各類負面攻擊與可預見的中國介選，恐會一再被操作，因此即時闢謠為關鍵要務，而議員團隊是最強的闢謠協力者。第四項要務則為強化部署監票部隊。
兼任民進黨主席的總統賴清德今天有其他行程安排，因此由總統府秘書長潘孟安代表出席。吳思瑤轉述，潘孟安會中提及，近期媒體揭露，不管是深偽影片、中國介選，或是檢調機關查辦的境外不法資金案例，層出不窮，行政團隊會維護民主選舉秩序，不容境外或不法勢力影響或介入，該做的執法一定嚴格執行，保護每一位守法的候選人。
至於最後階段的陸戰、空戰布局，吳思瑤說明，沈伯洋擅長空戰，團隊將持續推出社群影片、互動式政策總複習等內容；陸戰部分則會強化與各地宮廟、地方社團及里長等聯繫，顧好基層組織。
沈伯洋選前黃金週是否會去南投縣等地助選，吳思瑤說，跨縣市助選要以市政合作為前提，沈伯洋20日會前進台中市及南投縣，而且不只有沈伯洋，「洋流慧聚，杰伴童行」，民進黨新北市長候選人蘇巧慧、桃園市長候選人黃世杰、基隆市長參選人童子瑋都會一起出動，這就是新世代扛起新時代。
至於最後2週的活動規劃，吳思瑤指出，包括14日在二二八和平紀念公園舉行的「洋流祭」，以及15日舉行士林、北投關渡大會師等。關於大會師部分，提醒所有參與者，尤其是走水路的民眾，一定要注意安全，更要留意選罷法等相關規定，避免觸法。
民進黨台北市議會黨團總召王閔生說，面對最後16天可能出現的抹黑、造謠及負面攻擊，議員與支持者都會即時闢謠，也號召更多「小水滴」一起站出來，協助闢謠澄清。（編輯：謝佳珍）1151112

title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
summary: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit | TechCrunch Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit 9:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Hugging Face CEO Clément De
content:
Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit | TechCrunch
Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
9:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026
Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue briefly commented on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s departure on Thursday, calling it a “really sad day.” Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025.
“This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!,” Delangue wrote on X.
This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day!
But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!
— clem 🤗 (@ClementDelangue) November 12, 2026
The post is interesting as it implies that Huang’s departure is potentially worrying to open source advocates, and he’s attempting to offer reassurance.
As Nvidia’s CEO, Huang was known as a strong advocate for open source AI and open-weight models, which is why there could be concerns about how a company that’s no longer under his leadership will now approach this space.
After Nvidia announced its plans to acquire Hugging Face, the U.S. Department of Justice began making inquiries about how the deal would impact competition in the AI market, Reuters reported in October. While Nvidia pledged that the platform would preserve open support, it would also allow the company to control a major distribution channel for AI models.
The Hugging Face deal is still scheduled to close in the first half of 2027. Requests for further comment on the deal status and whether Hugging Face has spoken yet with Nvidia’s interim CEO Colette Kress were not returned.
Huang’s advocacy for open source and open-weight AI has long extended beyond Hugging Face. In July, the CEO published an AI policy letter as his first-ever post on the social network X. The letter, which was signed by 25 companies, including Microsoft, Meta, Hugging Face, IBM, Palantir, and others, urged the U.S. government not to over-restrict open-weight AI models. It said models that “anyone can download, inspect, modify, and run on their own infrastructure” are an important part of the AI ecosystem because they make AI “more accessible, adaptable, and widely available.”
Huang also wrote that open-weight models expand access to the AI economy, strengthen competition, and give customers greater control, as they know they won’t become locked into a single provider. “Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty,” his post on X stated.
For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter.
AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country.
Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C
— Jensen Huang (@JensenHuang) July 24, 2026
In August, Nvidia also announced a $6 billion deal with the coding startup Poolside to help build out an open AI ecosystem in the U.S. to help the country compete against Chinese companies like DeepSeek and Kimi K3, The Wall Street Journal reported at the time. Last month, Nvidia expanded its Nemotron family of open-weight models with a large 120-billion-parameter model for agents used by the enterprise as well as with two new lightweight Bolt models that run on PCs.
Earlier this year, Huang promoted open source AI during his January keynote address at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, noting that open source models have “really revolutionized artificial intelligence.”

content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋深陷婚外情及涉谍风波，成了近日国际要闻。英伟达星期四（11月12日）宣布他已辞职，由副手克雷斯暂代职务。 （路透社）
（华盛顿／台北综合电）英伟达董事会星期四（11月12日）上午宣布，首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，结束这几天围绕他去留的种种猜测。
较早前，美国媒体又爆料，黄仁勋除了与被指是中国情报员的黄乐发展婚外情，还疑似与公司一名已婚女高管有私情。
黄仁勋被公认为全球人工智能（AI）热潮的主要推动者之一，他在1993年创立英伟达，此次离职标志着他声誉的急剧跌落。
英伟达执行副总裁兼首席财务官克雷斯（Colette Kress）已同意担任临时首席执行官。（路透社）
英伟达宣布，执行副总裁兼首席财务官克雷斯（Colette Kress）已同意担任临时首席执行官。克雷斯说，她将继续推进相关工作，巩固英伟达在加速计算和AI领域的领先地位，并把握未来的机遇。
英伟达董事会在宣布黄仁勋辞职的声明中，高度肯定他在领导公司期间所作出的贡献。声明指出，英伟达是全球最具影响力的科技公司之一，并说董事会和公司感谢黄仁勋为公司及整个行业作出的巨大贡献。
黄仁勋辞职的消息宣布后，英伟达股价星期四开盘前交易猛跌超过10%，开盘一个小时后跌幅收窄至约5%。
随着黄仁勋的离职，这起婚外情及涉间谍风波会如何继续发展，仍受到广泛关注。
此前媒体分析指出，一旦黄仁勋被逼辞职，这意味一个由他掀起的全球AI热潮告一段落，影响层面远超英伟达本身的营运，整个AI行业都将受冲击。
《纽约时报》星期三报道称，英伟达五名前职员透露，黄仁勋与直属下属、医疗保健部门副总裁鲍威尔（Kimberly Powell，48岁）关系密切，而公司内部早就在谈论两人关系。
鲍威尔在领英的个人资料显示，她在2016年担任AI业务发展高级总监。2017年底，她出任医疗保健部门副总裁。（路透社）
鲍威尔已婚，她在2008年加入英伟达。根据公司网站介绍，她负责将英伟达的晶片技术，应用在高等教育和医疗保健领域，特别是在医疗影像设备方面。
鲍威尔在领英（LinkedIn）的个人资料显示，她在2016年担任AI业务发展高级总监。2017年底，她出任医疗保健部门副总裁。她经常出席全球各地的技术会议，并代表公司发表演讲。
纽时记者星期三致电黄仁勋（63岁）询问此事，他对记者说：“我觉得，你不应该直接跟我谈。” 然后挂断电话。
此外，彭博社报道，指疑似为中国国安部收集黄仁勋情资的黄乐已回返中国，目前人在北京。消息人士说，不清楚她为何及几时到北京，也不清楚在北京做些什么。
中国外交部星期四在例行记者会上，被问到中方能否证实黄乐目前人在北京时，中国外交部发言人毛宁回说：“我不了解你提到的情况。”
《华尔街日报》则在报道中引述多名熟知内情的人士披露，当初将黄乐介绍给黄仁勋的，竟是黄乐的丈夫康伟，
这名中国商人与黄仁勋相识10年。在长达两年的时间，康伟不仅默许妻子与黄仁勋搞婚外情，甚至还公开谈论两人的亲密关系。
报道指，康伟与黄乐善于利用人脉拓展商业版图。过去10年，这对夫妇接连押注多个暴利风口，从电子游戏、医药并购到云计算，每涉足一领域便编织起错综复杂的关联实体网络，在彼此名下腾挪股权，将手头人脉悉数变现。炙手可热的英伟达AI晶片，正是他们瞄准的最新猎物。
另一方面，台湾大陆委员会主委邱垂正星期四在立法院内政委员会回答询问时，透露黄乐在2024年至2025年间，总共入境台湾八次。
黄乐在2024年入境台湾三次，去年五次，今年则尚未有入境记录。邱垂正说，黄乐是以商业与香港居民身份赴台。
邱垂正说，台湾当局如今知道黄乐的身份，将依照港澳人士来台居留定居许可办法，以可能有危害台湾利益、公共安全和公共秩序之虞，给予注记，依法管制她入境。

Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

Malawi: Nationwide Protests Planned Over Malawi's Economic Challenges
Protesters carry signs during a Jane Ansah solidarity march in Blantyre.
Frustrated Malawians are preparing to take to the streets in nationwide demonstrations on 17 November 2026, piling pressure on the government over worsening economic hardships and failing public services.
The protests, organised by a group calling itself Concerned Citizens, are set to take place in major cities and districts including Lilongwe, Blantyre, Mzuzu, Zomba, Kasungu, Mulanje, Balaka, Mchinji, Salima, Chikwawa and Phalombe.
According to a circular issued by the organisers, demonstrators will demand answers over persistent fuel shortages, foreign currency scarcity, electricity blackouts, shortages of essential medicines in public hospitals, water supply disruptions and alleged passport scandals.
The group says Malawians are no longer satisfied with assurances and want government to provide clear, time-bound solutions to the country's mounting challenges.
Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn
In a move likely to increase political pressure, the organisers are also calling for the resignation of three Cabinet ministers whom they blame for failures in key sectors.
The ministers named are Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha, Health Minister Madalitso Baloyi and Energy Minister Jean Mathanga.
"The Concerned Citizens are demanding the resignation of the following Ministers," the circular states.
The planned demonstrations come as households and businesses continue to struggle with rising costs, shortages of essential commodities and unreliable public services.
Organisers say the protests are intended to force authorities to account for the country's challenges and outline when ordinary Malawians can expect improvements.
With anger growing over the state of the economy and public services, the demonstrations are expected to become a major test of public sentiment towards the government's handling of the crisis.

title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
summary: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement? | TechCrunch Image Credits:Nvidia (opens in a new window) Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement? 7:37 AM PST · November 1
content:
Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement? | TechCrunch
Image Credits:Nvidia (opens in a new window)
Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
7:37 AM PST · November 12, 2026
The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately.
This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan. But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia.
While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion?
According to Nvidia’s website, Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.
The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin, she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company.
According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time.
“Nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” Kress said in a statement. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.”
Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the company’s immediate future.

资料照片：在德国慕尼黑举行的慕尼黑安全会议期间，美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥与中国外交部长王毅会晤。(2026年2月13日)
美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)星期三(11月11日)应中方请求，与中国外长王毅通电话，讨论美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)下星期赴深圳出席亚太经合组织(APEC)领导人会议，以及中国国家主席习近平下月赴佛罗里达州出席二十国集团(G20)峰会的安排。美国国务院在通话纪要中提及，美中俄领导人可能举行三方会晤；中方发布的通话消息则未提及这一可能性。
美国国务院说，卢比奥与王毅重申了两国领导人此前就建立“基于尊重、公平和互惠的建设性战略稳定关系”达成的共识。国务院的通话纪要还说，双方认为，有实质内容的领导人对话有助于推进和平与无核化等目标，“包括在未来任何可能与俄罗斯举行的三方领导人会晤中”。这一措辞提到了三方会晤的可能性，但未宣布会议已经敲定，也没有公布具体议程。
中国外交部称，这次通话“是积极和建设性的”。据中方通报，王毅表示，中美关系目前的稳定势头来之不易，中方愿与美方加强沟通、妥善处理分歧，并相互支持办好今年的APEC和G20领导人会议。通报没有提及俄罗斯或无核化议题。
根据美国国务院发布的一份新闻稿，卢比奥与王毅都认为，领导人对话对于“推动和平与无核化”等目标至关重要。另一个特别引人注目的要点是新闻稿提及特朗普、习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)有可能在深圳举行三方会晤，而且“和平与无核化”也会包含在三边峰会讨论的议题之内。
APEC领导人会议定于11月18日至19日在深圳举行。特朗普总统此前表示，预计将在会议期间与习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)会面，并希望讨论无核化等问题。不过，三国领导人是否举行三方会晤，仍有待正式确认。
核议题可能是筹备三方会晤时的一项分歧。美俄《新削减战略武器条约》(New START)在今年2月4日到期后，双方已不再受该条约规定的战略核武器数量上限约束。卢比奥国务卿曾表示，美国目前倾向于推动包含中国在内的全新多边核军备控制框架。特朗普总统曾表示，他希望与习近平及普京讨论去核化问题；不过，中方尚未确认核军控议题是否会纳入可能的三方会晤议程。
北京则一直认为，中国的核力量与美俄不在同一量级，现阶段要求中国参加三边核裁军谈判“不公平、不合理、不可行”。美国国务院此次使用的“无核化”(denuclearization)一词，并未具体说明拟讨论的是核裁军协议，还是范围更广的核问题。
乌克兰此前已对可能举行的美中俄三方会晤表达关切。乌克兰外长安德里·西比哈(Andrii Sybiha)10月表示，乌美俄领导人会谈可能有助于结束战争，而美中俄领导人会谈可能产生相反效果。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)也在此前的采访中说，如果会晤讨论乌克兰问题，乌方希望事先得到征询。
“如果乌克兰议题被列入议程，我们希望各方能就此征求乌克兰的意见。至于其他方面，我无法置评，因为我不知道他们具体会讨论什么，”泽连斯基说。

title: 福建会馆首办挑战赛 青年为老字号“痛点”献创意夺冠
summary: 南洋艺术学院学生王俊毅（中）和他的队友陈骏逸（右起）, 何宇宁、陈克杰、莫皓凯一起夺得首届“传统文创新想象挑战赛”冠军。 （邝启聪摄） 本地历史最悠久的茶艺馆茶渊（Tea Chapter），计划开发手机应用吸引年轻人通过角色匹配来体验茶文化乐趣。这个新点子出自五名本地大学生组成的团队。他们为茶渊设计的创新发展计划，星期四（11月12日）在新加坡福建会馆主办的首届“传统文创新想象挑战赛”（Heritage Re-imagined Challenge ）决赛中夺冠。 冠军团队成员
content:
南洋艺术学院学生王俊毅（中）和他的队友陈骏逸（右起）, 何宇宁、陈克杰、莫皓凯一起夺得首届“传统文创新想象挑战赛”冠军。 （邝启聪摄）
本地历史最悠久的茶艺馆茶渊（Tea Chapter），计划开发手机应用吸引年轻人通过角色匹配来体验茶文化乐趣。这个新点子出自五名本地大学生组成的团队。他们为茶渊设计的创新发展计划，星期四（11月12日）在新加坡福建会馆主办的首届“传统文创新想象挑战赛”（Heritage Re-imagined Challenge ）决赛中夺冠。
冠军团队成员之一，南洋艺术学院（NAFA）三年级生王俊毅说，团队建议茶渊设计一款指导饮茶的聊天工具，同时引入不同人物，分别是茶艺大师、运动健将、学习伙伴，以及知心朋友，让年轻人接触不一样的茶文化。
这项挑战赛今年四月启动，邀请16岁至28岁的青年，组成三至五人的参赛队伍，从年轻消费者的角度找出本地老字号品牌目前运营时遇到的“痛点”，然后贡献解决方案助这些老字号在未来发展。
活动共吸引到15支队伍参赛，每支队伍必须选择一个老字号企业来“搭档”，最终有7支队伍入围决赛。
茶渊执行董事李凡接受《联合早报》访问时说，和本地年轻人熟悉的中国茶饮连锁店霸王茶姬 (Chagee）相比，茶渊想采用的是不同的发展模式，更希望提倡文化与传统的传承。
“现在很多人不想泡茶，但如果有一个人一步一步牵着你的手走，带你享受整个流程，又可以找到相匹配的人物陪你喝茶，那就不一样了。”
位于牛车水，1989年创立的茶渊，当时就设在本地旧屋保留计划下首间被修复的店屋，曾接待过已故英国女王。
在挑战赛中获得季军的，是由新加坡国立大学、南洋理工大学学生组队的项目，他们为友谊书斋（Maha Yu Yi）设计了游戏卡来吸引年轻读者。
友谊书斋负责人，友谊企业有限公司董事经理宋志忠受访时说：“小一到小六，家长都会带着孩子来买书，过后就有点断层，读者都是40多岁以上。用新奇的游戏卡片，能吸引更多年轻人。”
除了茶渊和友谊书斋，入选决赛的其他参赛队伍所相中的老字号还包括：白新春茶庄（Pek Sin Choon）、东兴饼家（Tong Heng）、可乐（Kele）黄梨饼，和德信药行（Teck Soon TCM Group）。
文化、社区及青年部兼能源贸工部高级政务部长刘燕玲星期四在活动上致辞时说，当局致力于与各界携手支持我国老字号企业。
“国家文物局去年推出了新加坡文化遗产企业计划（SG Heritage Business Scheme），首批获此殊荣的共有42家本地企业，涵盖餐饮店、书店、珠宝商行，以及传统中药行等。”
文化、社区及青年部兼能源贸工部高级政务部长刘燕玲（左）和福建会馆会长蔡其生，为新书悬疑漫画小说《天福宫迷案：御赐之礼失踪记》举行推介仪式。（邝启聪摄）
活动上也发行了本地首个将历史虚构故事与国家古迹天福宫相结合的悬疑漫画小说《天福宫迷案：御赐之礼失踪记》。
这本著作有中英文版本，由豆号出版（The Nutgraf Books）团队和新加坡福建会馆携手推出，书中的漫画插图由《海峡时报》前美术员谢森安绘制。
新书中虚构的悬疑故事，从一名年轻的天福宫文员寻找失踪文物牌匾的冒险之旅展开，故事背景为20世纪初的新加坡天福宫，在故事的推进过程中，融入这座国家古迹昔日用于举办婚礼、节庆和教育等活动的各种社会功能。

title: 公园局携手国大及国大医院编游戏手册 引导特需孩童大自然中玩
summary: 太和观治疗护理服务高级职能治疗师李讳琇，星期四带上7岁儿子汤智洋，到雅格巴拉斯儿童花园（Jacob Ballas Children’s Garden）与职能治疗师团队及媒体一同通过角色扮演，体验手册中的游戏。 （林明顺摄） 抗拒触碰泥沙枯叶，或面对陌生触感、声音、气味时容易过度反应、分心，甚至因感官过载而焦虑，这些是自闭症等特需孩子在接触大自然游乐时经常面对的障碍。 为协助特需儿克服障碍，国家公园局携手新加坡国立大学及国立大学医院，联合编制游戏指导手册，帮助特需孩童更好地融入
content:
太和观治疗护理服务高级职能治疗师李讳琇，星期四带上7岁儿子汤智洋，到雅格巴拉斯儿童花园（Jacob Ballas Children’s Garden）与职能治疗师团队及媒体一同通过角色扮演，体验手册中的游戏。 （林明顺摄）
抗拒触碰泥沙枯叶，或面对陌生触感、声音、气味时容易过度反应、分心，甚至因感官过载而焦虑，这些是自闭症等特需孩子在接触大自然游乐时经常面对的障碍。
为协助特需儿克服障碍，国家公园局携手新加坡国立大学及国立大学医院，联合编制游戏指导手册，帮助特需孩童更好地融入大自然，在探索中促进学习与身心发展。
这份名为《自闭症谱系障碍儿童大自然游戏指导手册》（A Nature Play Programme for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder Toolkit）星期四（11月12日）正式上线。
这套指导手册是由国家公园局、国大和国大医院的一项联合研究衍生而成。三方共同开发为期六周的大自然游戏活动，初步证实参与项目的自闭症谱系障碍儿童在情绪和社交行为上有明显改善。
指导手册将研究中的核心发现，转化成主要面向5岁至9岁儿童的早期干预实用策略。它不仅能指导职能治疗师和教育工作者等专业人员，将“大自然游戏”融入治疗与发展项目中，也方便家长和看护者参考，在家庭和社区中随时引领孩子开展亲近大自然的活动。
手册建议每次活动时长90分钟，分四个环节进行：先展开20分钟“热身”，让孩子熟悉环境，缓解对陌生事物的焦虑。随后进行“大自然游戏”和“团体游戏”各30分钟，分别通过由孩子主导的自由探索和与同伴的互动，促进情感连接及合作、轮流等社交能力。最后10分钟进入“缓和环节”，通过回顾与放松练习，帮助孩子平复情绪、平稳过渡。
指导手册为各个环节提供具体活动范例，例如在常见的“自然拓印”中，大人可以引导孩子收集树皮、落叶或石头垫在纸下，再用彩色铅笔涂抹拓出大自然的纹理；或是开展有趣的“制作树叶沙爹”活动，带着孩子捡落叶，再一片片用枯枝串起。
手册建议的其中一个游戏项目是“制作树叶沙爹”，带着孩子捡落叶，再将落叶一片片用枯枝串起。（林明顺摄）
同时，指导手册还以问答形式，教大人如何化解实际操作中的难题。例如，如果孩子对拓印不感兴趣，大人不必勉强，而是顺着孩子的情绪先表现出自己的好奇心，比如说：“看，这棵大树的树皮多凹凸不平，我们来看看印在纸上是什么样！”或是把拓印物品的选择权交给孩子。
面对注意力难集中、坐不住的孩子，则适合多进行短快多动的活动，如“一起去捡石头吧！”让孩子动起来；或将活动包装成“从这片森林中收集大自然线索！”。也要多夸奖孩子们在活动过程中付出的努力，而非最终成果，让他们的参与度和热情得以持续。
公众可上国家公园局网站https://go.gov.sg/nature-playgardens，免费下载大自然游戏手册，手册末尾附有活动单，方便直接打印使用。（林明顺摄）
太和观治疗护理服务高级职能治疗师李讳琇，此前在国大医院任职时曾参与开发这套手册。她星期四与公园局城市自然研究中心首席研究员黄淑凤博士等人一同向媒体介绍指导手册。
太和观治疗护理服务高级职能治疗师李讳琇（左）此前在国大医院任职时，与国家公园局城市自然研究中心首席研究员黄淑凤博士（右）等共同参与开发手册。两人星期四向媒体介绍这套新手册。（林明顺摄）
李讳琇受访时指出，特需儿童家庭通常高度依赖诊所或学校的专业治疗，一到假期或脱离这些环境，许多家长便不知该如何与孩子有效互动。推出这套手册，正是为了协助家长迈出第一步，即便少了专业人员，也能利用大自然环境在日常生活中引导孩子。
“相比喧闹的购物中心，大自然的环境刺激更容易调控。若孩子受到刺激困扰，可先到凉亭等地方冷静下来，再逐步引导他们感受蟋蟀、蛙鸣或触碰沙子和叶子，进行感觉统合训练。”

content:
Fundraiser by David Xia : Fighting for legal fairness
David Xia and 2 others are organizing this fundraiser.
Supporting Yeliang Xia with donation for legal defence against the evil fugitive billionaire Wengui Guo (most wanted by Interpol)
Mr. Yeliang Xia, a former professor at Peking University and a political dissident from China.
Mr. Xia has been sued for his inquiries and criticism through TV and twitter on Guo’s so-called exposure of top confidential information in China by Wengui Guo (aka Miles Kwok, a notorious Chinese billionaire and fugitive escaped from China in 2015 and Guo got RED NOTICE twice from INTERPOL) at Eastern District Court of Virginia.
Guo hired a gang of cyber accessories and made up tons of rumors to smear Mr. Xia and Xia’s family members while filing a complaint against Xia with an accusation of defamation and a claim of five million US $ for compensation.
Guo has been abusing legal resources in US with more than 41 lawsuits for defamation undergoing and he claimed that he planned to sue more than 91 persons for the accusation of defamation.
Mr. Xia and many other defendants can’t afford to hire a qualified and experienced attorney to defend themselves. Thus, with suggestions by many web bystanders, Xia started a campaign to collect donation for legal fees against Guo.
Xia will use those donations only for the purpose of the lawsuit and he has been supported by several volunteers to work on collection, bookkeeping and supervision of donations. The goal has been set to 100,000 US$, and an individual account of GoFundMe was set up as a major channel for donation.
Please contact Julia Lee and other volunteers through [email redacted] for the details.
We’re most grateful to your attention, encouragement, support and great help!
原北大教授、政治异议人士，现时政/财经新闻评论人夏业良先生（美国之音/自由亚洲电台/博讯/新唐人等媒体）因网络质疑和评论，而被中国逃亡商人郭文贵花钱组织围攻/抹黑，并在美国弗吉尼亚东区联邦法院提交所谓诽谤指控和滥诉。
夏先生通过电视节目和推特对郭的所谓爆料（包括最高机密信息）进行了质疑和批评，郭雇佣组织了对夏及其家人的网络围攻，同时指控夏对他进行诽谤并索赔五百万美元。
郭滥用美国司法资源， 目前正在进行中的诉讼超过41起，郭宣称他计划起诉至少91位对他进行诽谤的个人。
夏先生和其他被告均无力承担雇佣合格并有经验的律师之花费。因此在众多网络旁观者的建议下开始了募捐应对郭之诉讼的律师费用。
夏先生将把募捐得款只用于本案诉讼之中，并且得到若干志愿者的支持和帮助，他们协助收集募捐款项/记账与募捐监督等工作。本次募捐活动的目标已设定为十万美元，并且已经开设了一个名为“GoFundMe”之软件的募捐账户平台以作为主要募捐渠道。
请各位捐助者通过电子邮箱：[email redacted] 与Julia Lee等志愿者联系，以获得相关细节。

title: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI’s natural gas ambitions
summary: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI's natural gas ambitions | TechCrunch Image Credits:wenbin (opens in a new window) / Getty Images SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI’s natural gas ambitions 9:00 AM
content:
SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI's natural gas ambitions | TechCrunch
Image Credits:wenbin (opens in a new window) / Getty Images
SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI’s natural gas ambitions
9:00 AM PST · November 12, 2026
SoftBank might not be the first to invest in a hot trend, but when it does, it goes big.
Witness its $30 billion bet on OpenAI in early 2025 or its announcement in February that its SB Energy subsidiary would spend $33 billion on a 9.2-gigawatt natural gas power plant. If you can’t be first, be biggest, I guess.
That philosophy apparently spilled over into procurement, where orders were also supersized. Starting about two years ago, SoftBank reportedly put down deposits on more than 13 gigawatts of turbines, almost 50% more than it needed.
The decision to over-order undoubtedly helped secure turbines and speed up SoftBank’s projects.
“SB Energy did not have a choice except to overbook turbines in the future if they wanted some turbines right away,” Peter Gardett, CEO of Noreva, told TechCrunch via email.
The energy world was caught off guard by the swiftness and magnitude of AI’s rising power demands. Queues for turbine orders now extend into the early 2030s. As natural gas was shaping up to be a go-to power source for the AI boom, CEO Masayoshi Son bet that by deploying his investment firm’s significant war chest, he could corner a portion of the market. If the AI world wanted power for its data centers, it would have to come to him.
Now that bet appears to have fizzled. SoftBank announced a $7.1 billion quarterly loss on Tuesday, with over half of that stemming from losses related to power-generating equipment. The investor had paid turbine manufacturers nonrefundable deposits to secure orders, and now it considered much of those worthless.
The move was also a costly bit of price discovery, Gardett said. Rather than overpay and potentially still be short of turbines, SoftBank overpaid and over-ordered.
“This charge is just that price discovery finally happening,” Gardett said.
The magnitude of that misplaced bet — over $3 billion — reflects some of the electricity mania that has overtaken the AI world. Faced with years-long waits to connect to the grid, many hyperscalers and developers have turned to natural gas as a sort of energy security blanket, something that is proven and familiar.
As AI data centers spend more time in operation, their operators are getting a better feel for what’s required to keep them operating. Natural gas might seem like a safe bet, but there are still risks, including winter curtailments when supplies dip and demand spikes, Brent Nelson, senior managing director of markets and strategy at Ascend Analytics, told the Equity podcast Wednesday.
In light of that, Nelson said the grid might still be their best bet. Most data centers would be best served by a grid connection, albeit a smaller one than they might normally request. To make up for the shortfall, large batteries are a cost-effective choice, Nelson said. They’d help shave peak loads or ride out requests from the utility to curtail electricity use.
Data center operators might be coming to that same conclusion, leading the natural gas market to develop more slowly than SoftBank expected.
SoftBank’s natural gas-related losses are unlikely to have a domino effect, leading to mass cancellations of gas power plants. AI’s power demand appears to be too large for that. For now, natural gas is riding high, though SoftBank may have found its ceiling.

Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund | TechCrunch
Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund
7:18 AM PST · November 12, 2026
Norwest, a firm backed solely by Wells Fargo, has raised a $4 billion fund as it sets out to invest more in AI. This is the eighteenth fund for the 65-year-old multi-stage investment firm, and its largest to date.
The fund will be invested across various sectors and multiple countries, notably the United States, India, and Israel. But the big story here is AI, and Norwest’s plans to expand its investment in this area.
Norwest said Thursday it aims to capitalize on AI startups developing products and services across core industries such as consumer, healthcare, and technology. The investment firm, which has backed Plaid, Spotify, Uber, and Vuori, said it will continue to expand its investments in physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, and aerospace.
If that sounds like a broad approach, it is intended to be, Jeff Crowe, a senior managing partner at Norwest, told TechCrunch.
“We’re taking a broad approach to AI because its impact is broad,” Crowe added, as AI is not limited by industry, geography, or application. “Just as digital transformation did, AI transformation has the potential to touch most layers of enterprise, consumer, and healthcare solutions: networking, enterprise IT and applications. Adapting to an agentic environment means applying AI broadly across products and services that solve problems.”
Crowe added that the firm is particularly excited about early-stage companies building AI-native application and infrastructure, physical AI, domain-specific models, and cybersecurity solutions.
Some of the firm’s recent investments reflect this strategy. For instance, the firm invested in Coval, which builds tools to test and evaluate AI agents, and Generalist AI, a startup that has developed AI foundation models for robots.
Since the launch of its seventeenth fund, a $3 billion raise that closed in 2024, the firm has made more than 87 investments.

summary: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress | TechCrunch 8:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits:Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg / Getty Images Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to t
content:
Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress | TechCrunch
8:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026
Image Credits:Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg / Getty Images
Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said on Thursday, according to reports from Bloomberg and NBC News.
Huang, who stepped down as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
Huang has agreed to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving, which falls later this month.
The development comes after House Republicans Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford sent Huang a letter on November 4 requesting that he appear before their committees. Moolenaar chairs the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, Mast chairs the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and Crawford chairs the House Intelligence Committee.
“Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.”
The testimony will take place behind closed doors, though Mast said he expects the briefing to be recorded on video and transcribed.

title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
summary: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang's successor | TechCrunch 8:12 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits:Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor In the wake of the ind
content:
Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang's successor | TechCrunch
8:12 AM PST · November 12, 2026
Image Credits:Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images
Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
In the wake of the industry-shaking news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday, U.S. President Donald Trump is floating the idea that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over the position.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that “only one man” could take Huang’s place: Tim Cook of Apple.
“A Legend replaces a Legend!” he wrote.
Cook stepped down as Apple’s CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company, but he’s still very much involved with Apple. While John Ternus took over as Apple’s CEO, Cook transitioned into the role of executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors, which sees him continuing to engage with global policymakers and manage international relationships, including Apple’s relations with China.
Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang. Jeffrey Sonnenfeld, Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday, suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates. He wrote that Cook has “an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder,” in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs.
Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyone’s guess.
“Tim Nvidia,” however, doesn’t quite have the same ring as “Tim Apple” does.

content:
Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

Ghana: A Warming Pacific, a Hotter Ghana - Protect Yourself From El Niño
A climate phenomenon happening thousands of miles away in the Pacific Ocean is already having serious impact here in Ghana, with hotter, drier and dustier conditions expected in the coming months.
El Niño is raising concerns about heat-related illnesses and stress from exposure to hot temperatures, with vulnerable populations, including children, pregnant women, the elderly and outdoor workers, being worst affected.
But what exactly is El Niño, how can an event occurring so far away affect Ghana, and what can people do to stay safe?

El Niño is a naturally occurring climate phenomenon characterised by unusually warm surface temperatures in the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean.
Scientists explain that the warming changes the movement of winds and circulation of the atmosphere, influencing weather patterns across different parts of the world.
These changes can impact rainfall and temperature conditions thousands of miles away from the ocean.
Ghana has experienced previous El Niño episodes, including the strong events of 1982 and 1983, 1997 and 1998 and 2015/16, as well as a moderate occurrence in 2023/24.
Although the effects vary between episodes, the developing 2026/27 event is forecast to become one of the strongest on record, and Ghana is not exempted from its potential impact.
The Ghana Meteorological Agency (GMet) says the developing El Niño event is likely to influence the country's weather from late 2026 into the first half of 2027.
It forecasts hotter, drier and dustier conditions, prolonged dry spells, possible drought conditions and sudden heavy rainfall in some areas.
GMet says heat stress is expected to peak between February and April 2027, particularly in northern Ghana, and also warns of increased seasonal meningitis risk in northern parts of the country.
Environmental health expert at the University of Ghana's School of Public Health, Prof. Mawuli Dzodzomenyo, warns that prolonged exposure to excessive heat could cause related illnesses, including:
Heatstroke, where the body becomes overheated and can no longer regulate its natural temperature effectively.
Heat exhaustion, where excessive heat exposure results in loss of salt and water through sweating in the body.
Severe dehydration, involving excessive loss of bodily fluids.
Kidney-related conditions.
Increased cardiovascular problems.
Prof. Dzodzomenyo points out some warning signs that suggest the body is struggling to cope with the heat. They include:
He advises people to immediately move to cooler or shaded places, rest, drink water or seek medical attention if symptoms persist.
The public health expert also urges individuals and institutions to put simple protective measures in place to reduce the effects of heat.
Prof. Dzodzomenyo recommends the following precautions:
1. Stay hydrated: Drink water frequently. Do not wait until you feel thirsty before hydrating.
2. Reduce sun exposure: Avoid or limit strenuous activities during the hottest periods of the day.
3. Adjust working hours: Outdoor workers such as farmers, market women, hawkers and construction workers should, where possible, work early in the morning or late in the evening.

5. Protect vulnerable groups: Children, pregnant women and older people should avoid prolonged exposure to excessive heat. Schools should provide regular water breaks and schedule outdoor activities during cooler hours.
6. Follow weather updates: Pay attention to GMet forecasts and adjust daily activities accordingly.
Do not wait until the heat becomes unbearable before taking precautions.

content:
武吉阿曼警察总部商业罪案调查部总监鲁斯迪星期四（11月12日）在记者会宣布警方取缔诈骗团伙的成果，并展示团伙成员用来行骗的仿冒执法人员制服。 （马新社）
马来西亚警方10月在全国扫荡112个诈骗团伙呼叫中心，13天内逮捕932人。其中538人是中国公民，是落网人数最多的外国涉案者。
据《星洲日报》报道，武吉阿曼警察总部商业罪案调查部总监鲁斯迪星期四（11月12日）在记者会说，警方10月19日至31日在全国同步展开名为“Magpie 01/2026”的取缔行动。
他透露，警方展开153次突击行动，检查650个商业及住宅单位，全面打击全国各地的诈骗窝点。
他指出，落网的932人中，106人为马国公民，另外826人为外国人。落网者包括796名男子及136名女子。
被捕的外国人以中国公民占最多，共538人，其次是越南93人、台湾40人、印度尼西亚36人、日本21人、巴基斯坦18人，以及缅甸和菲律宾各14人。
这些被捕者有809人负责客户服务或操作员，另有70人是主管或小组负责人。
警方调查发现，这些诈骗团伙主要将公寓住宅当作犯罪据点。警方上述153次突击行动中，有106次或近七成是在公寓展开，34次在住宅、八次在度假村或酒店，其馀则涉及办公楼、店屋及仓库。
鲁斯迪指出，警方发现，这些团伙的诈骗手法有136种，其中虚假投资诈骗及爱情骗局各27起，其次是电话诈骗25起、网络赌博16起，以及虚假工作招聘11起。
警方发现，团伙并非只针对马国民众，而是将黑手伸向外国。根据团伙的144项诈骗记录，其中14项针对马国民众，其余130项都针对其他国家民众。
若按受害者国籍区分，中国有62项诈骗记录，其次是美国12项、越南及印尼各七项，日本和香港特别行政区各六项。
警方在行动中也起获大批干案工具，包括2058台手机、433台手提电脑或平板电脑、161台电脑或显示器、112台路由器或调制解调器、40本护照或签证，以及7辆交通工具，另有大批相关文件及设备。警方也充公10万2635令吉（约3万2300新元）现金。
鲁斯迪说，警方目前仍在深入追查幕后主脑、行动协调人员，以及负责管理资金和提供设施的相关人士，并通过数码鉴证、通讯记录及金融交易纪录，进一步揭开诈骗集团的完整运作网络。
警方也提醒民众，切勿轻信陌生人的来电、讯息或投资邀约，更不可随意透露银行资料、密码、一次性密码及交易授权码。
